articleTitle: Enhancing Solar PV Efficiency: A Comprehensive Review of ANFIS-Based MPPT Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This thorough research examines the use of Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) for Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) in solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. ANFIS, a hybrid intelligent system that integrates neural networks with fuzzy logic, is a viable alternative for enhancing the efficiency of photovoltaic systems. Utilizing its adaptive learning skills and proficiency in managing uncertainty, ANFIS can efficiently monitor the maximum power point (MPP) amidst fluctuating environmental circumstances. This paper offers a comprehensive examination of ANFIS-based MPPT tactics, emphasizing their benefits compared to conventional approaches, implementation factors, and prospective research avenues. Principal results demonstrate that ANFIS may attain enhanced efficiency, expedited reaction times, and more resilience relative to traditional MPPT methods, positioning it as a potential solution for optimizing solar power output.

articleTitle: Shadow Identification From The Dense Pixeled Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Information from the high-resolution satellite images can be extracted much more efficiently of present shadows of the objects or clouds from those images can be detected and removed. These shadow regions cause loss of information and sometimes get mixed with the darker objects. n satellite image processing, shadow occurrence may cause to deteriorate the information in the image. When there is any obstacle in the path of light, it may cause to shadow generation. In satellite images it occurs more as the position of the sun-rays keeps change their angle of elevation, and thus shadow created at different angles at different point of the time. Cloud shadows may also cause uncertainties in applications like Landmapping, surveillance, weather prediction, etc. In the proposed methodology, a dataset is created including some High-resolution and some Low-resolution satellite images, and using their different channels, like HSV, and extraction of their last available band, some shadow masks are generated.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection and Prevention at the End-User Level in Smart Grid Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In order to keep the electric power system running smoothly and reliably, it is constantly monitored and controlled by an intelligent cyber layer that consists of data processing algorithms and a wide network of sensors. Cyberattacks on this data processing and collecting system might halt operations and have catastrophic physical consequences like system breakdowns. A common kind of attack is the FDIA. To avoid detection by the state estimator's inherent anomaly detection capabilities, an attacker tries to trick the grid's underlying control system into producing disturbances. On top of that, there are major issues with customer-end security. For instance, criminals might intercept, alter, or replay wireless transmissions of power consumption signals sent by consumers to their utility provider. Consequently, smart grid security and privacy are major apprehensions. In order to prevent cyberattacks on the vital infrastructures of the electrical system, this thesis helps. New detection systems for the generating and transmission side, as well as the end-user customer side infrastructure, are the primary focus of the study. To protect the generating and transmission sides from cyber-attack, we provide a system based on intelligent sensor weights and an optimization strategy based on sophisticated grey wolves. In addition, to safeguard end-user customer data from cyberattacks, we provide a gaussian mixture model–based privacy protection strategy and an artificial neural structure–based intelligent loop detection method.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection from Chest X-ray Images Using 2D-LWP-EWT and SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The global surge of COVID-19, an unprecedented viral outbreak originating in China in 2019, method, real-time reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), though widely used, is critiqued for its lower sensitivity and prolonged detection time. This necessitates the development of more sensitive, accurate, and rapid screening techniques for mass application. Recent research suggests that chest X-ray images (CXRIs) can offer heightened sensitivity in COVID-19 detection. This paper proposes an image processing and decomposition-based approach to enhance the performance of COVID-19 detection from CXRIs. Leveraging the Two-dimensional Littlewood Paley Empirical Wavelet Transform (2D-LWP-EWT), the pre-processed image is decomposed into sub-band images (SBIs). Features extracted from these SBIs undergo post-processing (concatenation, normalization, selection, and singular value decomposition) before classification by a support vector machine (SVM). With impressive parameters 98.34% accuracy, 100% sensitivity, 96.67% specificity, 97.50% precision, and 98.57 F-Score obtained through 10-fold cross-validation (FCV), this method outperforms existing COVID-19 detection techniques.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Random Forest, SVM, and Naive Bayes for Sentiment Analysis Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study presents an in-depth evaluation of sentiment analysis models applied to a US Twitter dataset. The performance of machine learning models considered in this study are Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM) in both optimized and non-optimized forms, Multinomial Naive Bayes, AdaBoost, and Gaussian Naive Bayes. In this work TFIDF is utilized for vectoize text. For machine learning algorithms the Random Forest and SVM achieve training accuracies of around 99%, but showing the lower test accuracies which denotes the overfitting condition. Other models such as multinomial Naive Bayes and AdaBoost showed consistent performance across both training and testing data. Gaussian Naive Bayes' underperforms in the test data due to the models sensitivity to the data properties. Highest accuracy is achieved using the optimized support vector machine that represents the importance of hyperparameter tuning on model generalization.

articleTitle: Total Harmonic Distortion of Multifunctional Converter for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Electric vehicles are slowly making their way into the transportation world because they are good for the environment in a big way. But there aren’t many EVs on the road, even though a lot of them are being made. It is typically discouraged to not use these vehicles due to the power factor influence they have on the grid, the fact that the battery packs do not last as long, they are expensive, and charging them is difficult. The charging process of vehicle batteries has become one of the most persistent concerns in the industry. In addition, there is a growing interest in the amount of power that is needed to meet the requirements of these vehicles. Because charging is accomplished through the use of power converter modules, there are numerous power converter topologies available in current scenarios. This research reviews the state-of-the-art of converter modules for charging EVs and suggests the best topologies for charging EV batteries. There are multiple converters that are used in one topology in order to charge a battery, provide power factor correction, and control the motor in different modes of operation. There are also some isolated and non-isolated converters used in EV applications with multiple converters or more switches to achieve the best features of EVs such as being lighter, smaller, and cheaper at a high cost and with lower efficiency. In this paper MFC for EV with soft switching, lower magnetizing current, and minimum switching losses, which directly not affect the efficiency of the charging system.

articleTitle: From Words to Hate: Analyzing Predictive Features for Hate Speech Detection on X
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Hate speech or hate comments are in the form of racism and sexism which is common on different social media platforms like X, Instagram, Facebook, etc. Due to these reasons, there are many industries and academics interested in hate speech detection on social media. There are many data sets which encourage the use of crowd sourcing for the annotation effort. In this paper, provided an examination of the brighter knowledge of hate speech on random forest model by obtaining from training on expert and amateur annotations. Provided an evaluation on our own data set and run on own model on the data set which various user’s social media ID’s and mentioning with their comments on various posts and this data set which contain different categories comments like hate speech, offensive languages, hate speech and offensive language, and non-hate and offensive language. And in this model, random forest algorithm is used which helps to classify the result or detect the user entered language because of these systems trained on expert annotations outperform system trained on amateur.

articleTitle: Speech based region recognition using RNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Human speech analysis has long been a problem for engineering civilization due to elements including emotional state identification, artificial intelligence study, product assessment, and many more. The two main principles of voice or speech analysis are the identification of an individual's gender and location based on accent. This paper presents feature extraction method from the raw human voice to identify the location that a human voice belongs to. The process comprised a multi-stage pipeline extraction of pertinent features that capture geographical and environmental acoustic signals, including mean, Skewness, standard deviation, and Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs). The primary goal was to identify the phonemes in the Hindi words that were provided. The deep learning model makes use of the large collection of speech samples from the north, south, east, west, and centre areas of India. The retrieved features are used to train the model. The experimental results, which yield 97% classification accuracy using RNN across a variety of regional speech samples, illustrate the efficacy of the proposed design. By sharing our framework and this work, we hope to advance the area of signal processing by inspiring practitioners to experiment with similar systems.

articleTitle: Computational Strategies for Enhancing Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: As traditional energy prices have surged, there has been a growing focus on exploring renewable energy solutions such as solar, wind, and hydro power. It is crucial to achieve an optimal design, and this can be attained by reducing the net present cost (NPC), cutting down on investment costs, or by decreasing the levelized cost of energy (LCE), employing multi-objective optimization, and other methods. Recent investigations have aimed at enhancing the optimization, sizing, operational strategies, design, and control aspects of hybrid renewable energy systems (HRES). This paper offers a comprehensive examination of hybrid energy system optimization utilizing soft computing methods from the literature, marking a significant step forward in the field of renewable energy. The literature discussed illustrates how soft computing approaches serve as effective optimization tools for these systems.

articleTitle: Blockchain in Cloud EHR Systems: Security and Privacy Challenges and Solutions*
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: With the adoption of blockchain technology in cloud-based Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, many avenues in the effective management of crucial challenges related to data security and privacy are now open. Growing healthcare organizations have been using cloud infrastructures to manage and share patient's information in an efficient manner, and concerns about access by unauthorized persons, breach of data, and compliance with regulations have grown. Blockchain: This decentralized, tamper-resistant structure offers solutions for the preservation of confidentiality, integrity, and traceability of health data. In this paper, various blockchain-based techniques that were presented for the purpose of securing the cloud EHR systems have been surveyed based on their merits and demerits. Further in the study, the focus was given to privacy-preserving encryption, decentralized data management, and federated learning for improving scalability and performance within EHR systems. It also points to the complexity that would be involved in incorporating blockchain with existing healthcare infrastructures and possible solutions to overcome such challenges while being HIPAA compliant. The paper aims to contribute to the development of secure and efficient blockchain-cloud EHRs that are compatible with patient trust and security in modern healthcare.

articleTitle: A 13-Level Inverter with Level Shifted Variable Frequency Switching for THD Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The idea behind a multilayer inverter originated from the extension of inverters to more than two layers in order to lessen distortion from the basic sinusoidal waveform. A drawback of multiple level inverters is the need for additional switches, which adds bulk and expense to the system and reduces system dependability due to the increased number of components. The increment in inverter levels reduces the distortion in outcome. The distortion can also be reduced by employing efficient switching techniques so in this work, a variable different switching techniques have been tested with a symmetrical 13 level inverter (13-LI) and their outcomes are compared with 180 degree shifted adjacent level pulse span modulation. The MATLAB platform is used to build the model and variable switching scheme, and the usefulness of the outcome is examined via analysis.

articleTitle: Detecting Malicious Insiders In Social Networks And Mitigating Cyber Threats With Advanced Security Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: When a fraudster uses a false identity to appear as a reliable source in an OSN, this kind of assault is known as an insider attack. The identification of users' actions inside the network is now a popular use of Machine Learning (ML) techniques. This study introduces Social Network Malicious Insider Detection (SID), a hybrid method that combines LSTM and TBTE. By keeping tabs on user data, the proposed SID hopes to spot data anomalies in OSN interactions. To accurately forecast user behaviour and detect the abnormality pattern in OSN, the suggested SID use LSTM, a more sophisticated kind of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). A time-based trust assessment approach is used with the LSTM to distinguish between new users, broken nodes, and malicious nodes in OSNs, as well as to accurately classify anomalous nodes. In addition to effectively detecting insider assaults, the proposed SID also decreases wrong apprehensions by offering a new measurable investigation for calculating the corresponding factor over time. This analysis prevents the mistaken characterization of legitimate user behaviours as abnormalities. In comparison to the preexisting RNN, LSTM, and Bilateral LSTM, the suggested SID achieves a greater detection accuracy, according to the evaluation results.

articleTitle: High Speed Quantum Cloud Cryptography using Elliptic Paraboloid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Mathematical properties of an elliptic paraboloid were used for high-speed encryption on quantum cloud. Encryption time nanoseconds, diffusion and confusion were measured. These observations proved that elliptic paraboloid was more secure against side channel attacks. Circle was used for encryption. Decryption was done by elliptic paraboloid. It was proved that ciphertext size was less as compared to the plaintext size. Complexity of elliptic paraboloid cryptosystem was O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). The design was independent of hardware. It could be implemented as both block cipher and stream cipher. Key management, distribution and handling were made easier. Block size and key size were flexible. Comparative analysis was made with both symmetric and public key cryptosystems. Experiments have proved that the novel design was better. Experiments were done with UTF-8 encoding. Modifications could be done to provide digital envelope and digital signature. Cryptosystem was compatible with quantum hardware. Dependance on insecure XOR and prime numbers was reduced. Elliptic paraboloid was applied both as symmetric and asymmetric key cryptosystem. Possibility of hardware implementation was also studied.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Detection from Chest X-Ray Images Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work proposes the Covid-DWNet deep learning-based architecture for the quick identification of Covid-19 and other symptoms from chest CT and X-ray images. Depth-wise dilated convolutions (DDC) units and feature reuse residual block (FRB) units form the foundation of the architecture, which effectively extracts a variety of features from the chest scan pictures. The proposed architecture greatly enhances the ability of CT images and X-ray images to recognize Covid-19 and other pulmonary diseases. In addition, Skip connections were introduced from the first Feature Residual Block layer to the last Feature Residual Block layer for the retention of features in the tensors. An accuracy of 98.44% is achieved on X-ray images as compared to 96.8% in the Covid-DWNet architecture. In addition, Skip connections were introduced from the first Feature Residual Block layer to the last Feature Residual Block layer for the retention of features in the tensors. An accuracy of 98.44% is achieved on X-ray images as compared to 96.8% in the Covid-DWNet architecture.

articleTitle: Leveraging Augmented Reality for Dynamic Visualization of Kirchhoff’s Voltage Law
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In this study, an augmented reality (AR) application aimed at supporting the instruction of Kirchhoff Voltage Law (KVL) through interactive, real-time circuit representation was developed. Users then scan physical markers representing circuit components, to see voltage dips in a virtual environment. The product uses AR technology to present students with an interactive accessible environment for learning and practicing their KVL concepts in a more immersive way by binding the abstract understanding of theory with practice. The program was subsequently tested for usability and functionality and it demonstrates a smooth user-friendly experience. The configuration allows circuit combinations to be changed simply and allows for more in-depth study of electrical principles. The authors identify future development goals as extending the system to more sophisticated circuit analysis topics and integrating it with online learning platforms further, which suggests the potential of AR in disrupting electrical engineering education.

articleTitle: Forecasting Air Pollutant Emissions in Thermal Power Plants: A Study of Prophet and ARIMA Models at Satpura Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The proposed study investigates the application of Prophet and ARIMA forecasting models for predicting air pollutant emissions at the Satpura Thermal Power Plant in Sarni, Madhya Pradesh, India. The plant’s substantial role in regional electricity generation necessitates accurate emission forecasts for effective environmental management. The study reviews the plant’s environmental impact and examines various forecasting methods, with a focus on Prophet and ARIMA. Data from 2019 to 2023 were meticulously preprocessed. The Prophet model achieved a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 7.8, providing smooth forecasts and capturing long-term trends. The ARIMA model, with an MAE of 8.67, was effective for short-term fluctuations but less smooth. The findings suggest Prophet’s superior trend forecasting capability, while ARIMA handles short-term variations. Future research should explore hybrid models and additional variables to enhance forecasting accuracy. AI-driven systems are recommended for better operational efficiency and environmental compliance.

articleTitle: Wearable devices technologies and innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In recent years, wearable technology has become a major technical breakthrough. These devices blend in seamlessly with daily life to monitor a variety of lifestyle and health metrics. These devices collect real-time data on a variety of topics, including heart rate, physical activity, sleep habits, and more. They are usually worn on the body or integrated into clothing. By using sensors and connection characteristics, they enable proactive well-being management by giving consumers insightful information about their health measurements. In this analysis. This paper examines the present landscape of wearable technology and its advancements. Additionally, a practical example will be provided, showcasing the capabilities of different wearable devices designed to deliver cutting-edge solutions for wireless communication, navigation, and data sharing. Finally, the paper will address the current obstacles faced by wearable technology and explore the future potential of smart wearable systems.

articleTitle: UAV Platform for Real-time Indoor Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: SLAM enables Robots and UAVs to effectively understand unknown surroundings and estimate their own position within those environments. Recent advancements in 2D mapping have significantly increased its popularity for navigation tasks, primarily because it is easier to generate and requires less computational power compared to 3D mapping. This paper provides a comparison of two widely used ROS-based 2D SLAM libraries: Google Cartographer and Hector SLAM, deployed on a custom built UAV that uses 2D LiDAR, and finds Hector SLAM to be more feature rich as well as computationally efficient.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna Array for X - Band Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The efficacy and benefits of microstrip patch antennas, including their light weight, compact design, and affordability, render them an ideal choice for communication systems. The integration of microstrip patch antennas with microwave circuits renders them suitable for applications such as cellular devices, WLAN systems, and GPS technologies. This paper presents the design and testing of tiny rectangular patch antennas for X-band communication signals at 11.845 and 11.919 GHz. The objective of this research is to examine array antennas that include two and four elements. The designed antenna was constructed and tested in a laboratory setting.

articleTitle: Probing the architectural and protocol design depths for edge computing excellence in Web3.0
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The suggested strategy for excellence in edge computing architecture and protocol design in Web 3.0 begins with issue awareness. We must carefully examine the Web 3.0 difficulties and needs of edge computing. Latency reduction, distributed data management, security, and user autonomy are key. Scholars initiated this path by comprehending the ultimate goal of Web 3.0 and its potential impact on architectural design and protocols. We study current approaches and field research before designing. This helps generate new ideas and identify problem areas. This first step guides assessment criteria and permits comparison with standards. Using various scenarios and edge computing setups, the offered solutions are evaluated, and latency, throughput, and resource use are monitored. Comparing new edge computing solutions helps evaluate the technology. This comparison analysis shows how effectively the suggested solution handles Web 3.0-specific issues like edge computing. We maintain extensive documentation to share study findings, methods, and conclusions with the scientific community. Sharing knowledge early promotes industry cooperation and progress.

articleTitle: Review the Difficulties, Concerns and Application Range of the Ultra-Wide Band Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Over the past ten years, research on broadband and ultra-wideband antennas has been discussed in this article. Various techniques were used to increase the antenna's impedance bandwidth. Several techniques were used to expand the impedance bandwidth of the antenna. There is discussion on the characteristics, applications, and scope. Numerous issues are noted and addressed, as well as potential fixes. We discuss a number of techniques, including the slotting technique, electromagnetic-band gap (EBG) structures, parasitic patches, various ground structures, multilayer structures, harmonic suppression techniques, radiating patches and ground structures of different shapes, multiple laminated conductors, and many more. This document provides support to researchers working in the subject of antenna design.

articleTitle: Advancements in Hybrid Electric Vehicles through Isolated SEPIC Converter Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study explores the use of isolated Single-Ended Primary-Inductor Converters (SEPIC) in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs) to address the environmental impact of traditional combustion engines. It focuses on the role of SEPIC converters in boosting HEVs' efficiency and performance, particularly under varying loads. The paper analyzes different SEPIC configurations and their applications, including solar charging and regenerative braking energy systems. It combines theoretical and practical insights to show how these converters effectively manage energy in HEVs, enhancing efficiency and reducing ecological footprints. The study also discusses the challenges and prospects of SEPIC implementation, from performance optimization to cost-efficiency and thermal management.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-Based Cluster Head Management with Artificial Flora Optimization for Energy-Efficient and Secure Routing in Fog-Enabled Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A wide variety of smart home, smart city, and smart space automated applications have contributed to the Internet of Things' rapid growth in the past few years. A lot of real-time Internet of Things (IoT) applications rely on Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) because of how reliable, efficient, flexible, and scalable they are. It has a cluster of geographically specific sensors that capture and analyze data about the physical characteristics of the surrounding area. Increased latency and decreased performance are consequences of the massive amounts of information being handled and saved in the cloud. Particularly in mission-critical, delay-sensitive Internet of Things applications, concerns like latency, protection, and conservation of energy must be addressed. To get around this problem, fog technology has been implemented, whereby end-user-located IoT devices do all the processing and storage locally, rather than constantly sending raw data to the internet. Fog computing in conjunction with WSN provides excellent options for monitoring surroundings pertaining to monitoring with their inexpensive, environmentally friendly, and low-bandwidth sensors, as well as for developing a safe and efficient framework for data transfer. The primary goals of this study are to design a deep learning-based intrusion detection mechanism for use in fog-based WSN environments, as well as an energy-efficient cluster-headed organization and multi-objective optimum routing method. The findings reveal that the recommended FAFOC system outperforms LEACH, P-SEP, and FEAR in network lifespan, active nodes, and usage of energy, 98% of packet distribution ratio, and latency. FAFOC is the most cost-effective network of wireless sensors because fuzzy reasoning and artificial vegetation optimization boost network effectiveness.

articleTitle: Efficient Multiplier design using CNTFET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Binary multiplier has been playing a vital role in digital signal processing, Arithmetic logic Unit (ALU), Embedded systems and Machine Learning. The multiplier has been designed using CMOS for a long time. Carbon Nanotube Field-Effect Transistors (CNTFETs), by virtue of their remarkable electrical capabilities, offer a promising solution for the electronics of the future. Their importance is further highlighted by their ability to counteract short-channel effects in conventional CMOS technology, which are linked to greater carrier mobility and improved electrostatic control. In this work, a two-bit multiplier is constructed utilizing a variety of CMOS technologies. The carbon nanotube field effect transistor (CNTFET) is utilized to get around the CMOS multipliers' power and delay constraints. Using the Cadence Virtuoso tool, a comparison of several CMOS multipliers that are now in use and those that have been proposed is conducted. Predictive Technology Models (PTM) are utilized for CMOS, while Stanford CNFET Model – Verilog-A is used for CNTFET analysis.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Robotics: Exploring the Transformative Potential of Graphene - A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Graphene, a two-dimensional carbon allotrope, has received a lot of attention in recent years because to its exceptional features, including as excellent electrical conductivity, mechanical strength, and flexibility. In robotics, these qualities hold enormous promise for transforming robotic system design and performance. This paper looks at graphene's possible applications in robotics, emphasizing sensor technology, actuation mechanisms, structural components, and energy storage. Graphene's unique qualities enable breakthroughs in a variety of robotics areas, including the development of lightweight and durable robotic platforms, the enhancement of sensor capabilities for environmental perception, and energy efficiency. This paper also addresses existing problems and future approaches for incorporating graphene into robotic systems, such as scalability, manufacturing methodologies, and cost-effectiveness. Overall, the synthesis of graphene-based materials with robotics gives interesting prospects to construct next-generation robots with better performance, adaptability, and functionalities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Learning of Kirchhoff’s Current Law through Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the design and development of an augmented reality application dedicated for educational purpose to better scaffold knowledge transfer regarding Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) in higher secondary students. Students can touch and interact with virtual circuit components using the AR tool that makes abstract subjects more tangible and fun. The AR tool used on an experimental group and traditional instruction applied on a control group were part of a study. There was significant increase in the average knowledge post-test when compared to pre-test in experimental group as compared to control group. In addition, student of the experimental group revealed that AR application makes itself more engaging and enthusiastic in learning KCL The interactive nature of the experience allowed for a better understanding of circuit theory and experimentation with electricity. Overall, the results suggest that AR-based learning can be used to significantly deepen students' understanding of complex physics topics and provide an effective complementary teaching resource. The study also provides evidence for the utility of AR in wider STEM educational contexts.

articleTitle: A Hybrid TDOA-ANN Framework for Accurate Real-Time Node Localization in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A prototype autonomous Wireless Sensor Network node based on a microcontroller for the prognosis and forecasting of fire accidents in multi-store buildings is presented in this thesis. The system has been evaluated for its dependability and resilience, and it reacts precisely in 300 ms. One range-based localization approach that uses the Hyperbolic based least square, Taylor series based least square, and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) methods is the TDOA based localization, which aims to achieve real-time communication of sensed data. Solving the very nonlinear systems of equations with the help of the least square estimator yields the predicted locations of the sensor nodes. The suggested procedures can only be replicated with accurate TDOA measurements. Different methods can be used to calculate TDOA: one uses the hyperbolic based method, which takes into account the difference between two TOAs; another uses the Taylor series based method, which takes into account the difference between round-trip TOA measurements between a sensor node and an anchor node; and yet another uses the TDOA measurement that results from the difference between the times of arrival of Ultrasonic pulses and RF signals transmitted from a sensor to an anchor node simultaneously. The hyperbolic technique outperforms the Taylor series by a little margin and accomplishes precise localization, according to the simulation findings. The ANN technique is both practical and simple to use.

articleTitle: Automatic Billing System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of digital transactions, the efficiency and accuracy of billing systems are paramount. The checkout process, from the ordinary retail shop and online shops, demands speed and accuracy in digital transactions. AutoBill is an innovation of a new AI checkout system that will transform the current retail checkout method through machine learning with additional powers from image recognition and real-time data storage. It is built on the Raspberry Pi platform while using TensorFlow’s object detection model but uses Google’s Teachable Machine. It integrates MongoDB for dynamic data handling. AutoBill automatically removes the human factor of billing, providing a seamless and efficient solution that reduces manual intervention enhancing overall transaction accuracy. The paper details a system design, implementation, and performance evaluation that shows promise of revolutionizing contactless shopping experiences.

articleTitle: Improved BD-EMD Technique using RBF Hermite Interpolation for Image Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Presented herein is an enhanced bi-dimensional empirical mode decomposition (BD-EMD) technique incorporating radial basis function with Hermite interpolation (RBF-HI) for image decomposition. Random point interpolation is an integral aspect of BD-EMD. The characteristics of the two-dimensional intrinsic mode functions (2D-IMFs) derived from BD-EMD significantly hinge on the employed interpolation technique. This study systematically examines various interpolation methods, advocating for the adoption of the RBF-HI technique to augment the performance of BD-EMD. Through comprehensive analysis and comparison of diverse interpolation techniques, crucial features of BD-EMD, including precise surface interpolation and image reconstruction, are refined for enhanced optimization. The outcomes attest that the proposed RBF-HI technique outperforms other methods in terms of surface interpolation, demonstrating superior curve fitting and reconstructed image quality. A standard test image of Lena is utilized for performance benchmarking against existing methods. Comparative analysis concludes that the proposed method excels not only in image decomposition but also in image reconstruction. Performance metrics, encompassing processing time, algorithmic complexity, and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), underscore the efficacy of the proposed method as a superior approach to BD-EMD for image analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient and Secure Data Handling in IoT Networks: Robust Lightweight Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A network of physical things that are outfitted with sensors, smart networking, and RFID technology is referred to as the "Internet of Things" (IoT), which is an abbreviation for the phrase. The items in question are able to communicate with one another and share data with other systems and devices respectively. Information security is of the utmost importance since by the year 2020, there will be more than fifty billion devices connected to the internet. Traditional cryptography, such as the Advanced Encryption Standard (DES) and the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), does not take into account the necessary hardware and software, the amount of power consumed, the size of the code, or the amount of memory overhead. NLBSIT, an Energy Efficient and Low-Pooled Memory Cryptographic Algorithm, and a Robust Lightweight Algorithm are the three lightweight encryption methods that are described in this thesis. NLBSIT is an acronym for natural language based secure information transfer. These algorithms are intended for use with devices connected to the Internet of Things. In order to solve the problems that Internet of Things devices encounter, such as excessive memory usage, power consumption, and energy consumption, these algorithms have been developed.

articleTitle: A 23-Level Asymmetric Inverter with Fewer Switches to Lower Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The expansion of inverters to numerous layers to reduce distortion from the fundamental sinusoidal waveform gave rise to the concept of a multilayer inverter. The disadvantage of using multiple level inverters is that it necessitates the installation of additional switches, increasing the bulk and expense of the system and decreasing its dependability because of the increased component count. To solve the problem of the system being larger, more costly, less reliable, and with less distortion as compared to a symmetrical H-bridged nineteen-level inverter, a nineteen-level inverter (23-LI) with fewer switches is proposed in this research." The concept is worked out on the MATLAB platform, and the efficacy of the outcome is assessed via analysis.

articleTitle: A 15-Level Inverter with Shifted-Level Variable Frequency Switching for Harmonic Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The expansion of inverters to more than two layers with the goal of reducing distortion from the fundamental sinusoidal waveform gave rise to the concept of a multilayer inverter. One disadvantage of multiple level inverters is the need for more switches, increasing system bulk and cost while decreasing system reliability because of the extra components. The result distortion is lessened by the increase in inverter levels. In this study, a variety of switching approaches have been tried using a symmetrical 15 level inverter (15-LI) and their results are compared with 180 degree shifted adjacent level pulse span modulation. Effective switching techniques may also minimise distortion. The model and variable switching scheme are constructed using the MATLAB platform, and an analysis is performed to determine the utility of the result.

articleTitle: A Fog-Driven Interpretable Human Motion Acknowledgement Structure with Edge Intelligence for Real-Time, Low-Latency Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Many healthcare applications, including fall detection and assisted living, are now making use of Human Activity Recognition, a field of active study. All over modern society, people are using these apps that cater to the Internet of Things. The need to make rapid, informed judgments is a major obstacle in many applications. As a possible answer to the latency problem, hierarchical edge-fog-cloud computing structures might be implemented. We next examine a fog-based activity detection system in our second piece of work, which involves collecting and transmitting patient sensor data to fog nodes. In the fog, these data are pre-processed, filtered, and evaluated to make dynamic judgments using Deep Learning. One component of the suggested system is a Deep Learning framework that has been brought up on the cloud. To guarantee that the Fog layer has intelligence, the trained Deep Learning framework is configured to operate on local fog nodes for the purpose of categorizing human activities. In this study, we provide an IHAR paradigm to bolster Human Activity Recognition by providing context for the findings. The use of Transparent Human Activity Recognition was highlighted by the successful model-level observations on the categorization. This study also compared the outcomes of other current Explainable AI reproductions, such LIME and SHAP, to find out which one performed improved when it came to Human Activity Recognition.

articleTitle: Advanced PMU Placement through Matrix Modification and ILP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: State estimation in power methods using only PMUs requires complete method observability through Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs). The challenge of determining the minimum no. of PMUs to achieve full observability in a network stands an optimization problem. Thstands paper presents a model for optimal PMU Location in electrical power networks. The objective stands to identify the optimal set of measurements that ensure full network observability under normal operating conditions, without considering PMUfailures or Power line outages. Observability stands analyzed using topological observability rules. The optimization stands performed using a matrix modification-based ILP method to minimize the no. of PMUs and determine thire optimal locations while adhering to relevant constraints. The proposed Strategy stands evaluated through replications on 30-point and 39-point trial methods, and the Outcomes are compared with exstandsting techniques to demonstrate its effectiveness. In all replications, Inactive Inoculation pointes are included to enhance the accuracy of the Outcomes.

articleTitle: Electric Spring and Smart Energy Meter for Power Factor Correction of Industrial Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Electric Spring (ES) technology has been suggested for voltage regulation, power regulation, active/reactive power compensation, renewable energy sources integration, grid stability, demand side management and more. In this paper Diode Clamped Converter based ES (DCC-ES) is presented for power factor (PF) improvement in three phase industrial loads that are resistive-inductive in nature. In this paper ES is implemented with Smart Energy Meter (SEM). This scheme can significantly improve PF in industries, reducing energy bills and penalties. This scheme can relieve grid burden and improve current carrying capacity in conductors, it opens new possibilities for the ES to be utilized for distributed implementation in industries along with Smart Energy Meter. The data from SEM can be used for load forecasting, monitor and control, accurate billing, real time tariff and so on in smart grids.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Distribution Line Insulator for 11KV Systems: A Study of Electrical Performance and System Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Reliable distribution line insulators play a critical role in ensuring the safe and efficient transmission of electrical power across long distances. This study aims to comprehensively analyze key factors such as voltage distribution, electric field intensity, current density, and Joule heating in line insulators under different conditions, namely clean and polluted states. By introducing a thin layer of pollution on the insulator's surface, the research simulates real-world contamination scenarios. The analysis is conducted using two-dimensional finite element method (2-D FEM) software to simulate an 11 kV line insulator with a constant shed design. Detailed comparisons are made between the clean and polluted insulators, offering insights into how surface pollution can impact the performance and reliability of power transmission systems. The findings of this study can help in improving the design and maintenance strategies for insulators, ultimately enhancing grid reliability.

articleTitle: PRISM: Profiling Hate Speech Spreaders using SVM and RoBERTa Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The prevalence of social media in the modern era has led to a concerning issue like the proliferation of hate speech. Twitter, with its massive user base of nearly 237.8 million people actively participating daily, has become a breeding ground for individuals who propagate offensive content, including racism, misogyny, and other forms of derogatory language. Proactive measures to identify and hold accountable individuals spreading hate speech on Twitter are essential. To address this we have proposed work for detection of the hate speech spreader. We have used the dataset provided by PAN @CLEF 2021 and specifically focused on the English language. For model training, we have employed four distinct approaches: Support Vector Machines (SVM),bidirectional LSTM,bidirectional GRU and transformer models. The SVM model employed TF-IDF vectorization to accurately represent the content of the tweets, whereas the transformer model utilized the Roberta tokenizer and a pre-trained Roberta model for effective text encoding. Hyperparameter optimization was performed using random search to enhance model performance. The RoBERTa model outperformed other models with an accuracy of 84%. The SVM model achieved an accuracy of 82%, while the Bidirectional LSTM and Bidirectional GRU models achieved accuracies of 56% and 63% respectively. These results highlight RoBERTa’s superior performance in detecting hate speech spreaders on Twitter.

articleTitle: Implementing Psychophysiological Evaluation for Cognitive Skill Improvement in Basketball Players
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Enhancing cognitive skills in athletes through brain signals is a fascinating research area. In order to attain optimal performance in sports competitions, athletes must improve their cognitive abilities in addition to their physical abilities. The present study aims to enhance the mental ability of selective attention in basketball players at university. Twenty athletes took part in the research work, 10 of them received intervention (experiment group), while the other 10 received no intervention (control group). A game based on computer is applied as an intervention corresponding to selective attention skill. The players' electroencephalogram (EEG) data are collected as part of the physiological evaluation of these athletes. The d2 Test of Attention is administered to 20 players as part of the psychological evaluation in order to evaluate their selective attention skill. According to the psychophysiological findings, a greater proportion of the athletes who participated in the intervention are able to enhance selective attention skill than the players in the control group. Pearson correlation coefficient has been used to assess the test-retest reliability for the psychological as well as physiological tests. The effect of the aforementioned intervention on enhancing cognitive skill is demonstrated by the values for Pearson correlation coefficient comparing the pre-testing and post-testing outcomes.

articleTitle: A SISL Triple-Band Antenna With E-Strip for Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work simulates a triple-band antenna for satellite communication, WiMax/WLA, and 5G mobile applications using substrates integrated suspended lines technology (SISL). The suggested SISL features five layers with incorporated air holes. The proposed antenna contain every element which has driven itself as self packaged . By crafting a circular patch etched with a U slot in the G5 layer and a rectangular slot in the G9 layer, we achieved dual bands at 2.36 GHz and 6.4 GHz, each with a bandwidth from 2.33 GHz to 2.4 GHz and 6.36 GHz to 6.82 GHz, accompanied by gains of 1 dBi and 10 dBi, respectively. The antenna design got better frequency performance when an Estrip was added to layer G2. This caused a triple-band resonance to appear at 3.51 GHz, with a bandwidth of 3.46 GHz to 3.56 GHz and a gain of 5.26 dBi. Vias establish connectivity between the feedline and circular patch, enhancing signal transfer and linking with the E-strip. Side lobe levels less than - 12.5 dB for enhanced antenna performance.

articleTitle: AI Affinity Unraveling Cross Synergies in the NGMA Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This plan links the Next Generation of Multidisciplinary Approach (NGMA) Framework to AI ethics, innovation, and the environment. SustainAlign, EthixScan, and InnoMerge are three of our most important methods. These methods help AI projects be more ethical, last longer, and be more creative. Equations in math make everything more balanced. When putting together and organizing AI project data, it's important to think about ethics, the environment, and the best ways to make things. Any AI project can get a score from SustainAlign for how sustainable it is. This number shows how long the project will last by looking at how it will affect the world and how many resources it will use. EthixScan computes the ethical commitment score to assess the ethical nature of AI solutions, taking into account their openness and bias levels. InnoMerge assigns an Innovation Catalyst Score to AI projects that integrate important goals to generate new ones. The final Cross-Synergy score is determined by adding the marks for innovation, ethics, and the environment. We find the best AI project pairs by using a multi-objective optimization method that takes into account limited resources and raises the overall cross-synergy score.

articleTitle: Review on SIW Antennas for mm-wave band of 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work aims to provide a review and the advancement of substrate-integrated waveguides (SIW) antennas and arrays with different topologies and performance levels. Based on the literature techniques like gain improvement, size reduction and bandwidth enhancement are also covered. For the advancement of components that function in the millimeter wave range, SIW technology is a very good option because it serves as a bridge between planar and nonplanar technologies. As a result, SIW antennas and arrays combine the features of planar antennas include light weight, low profile, affordable manufacture and conform to bent or plane surfaces and high-power capacity, high gain, low cross polarization, and good selectivity of a classical metallic waveguide combined in an intuitive way with planar surfaces. Several papers on SIW antennas were reviewed and corresponding details were presented here.

articleTitle: Review on SIW Antennas for mm-wave band of 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work aims to provide a review and the advancement of substrate-integrated waveguides (SIW) antennas and arrays with different topologies and performance levels. articleTitle: Synthesis Optimization Techniques: A focus on Retiming and Multibit Insertion Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper presents a study on optimizing area and power in the synthesis process through the use of retiming and multibit insertion techniques. Enhancing the functionality and effectiveness of digital circuits running on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) and Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) is the aim of this research project. First, the paper provides an overview of the retiming and multibit insertion techniques and their impact on circuit timing, area and power consumption. Then, a detailed analysis is presented, demonstrating the effectiveness of these techniques in reducing area and overall power consumption in various circuit designs by maintaining the time almost constant to its previous values. Experimental results show that the combined use of retiming and multibit insertion can lead to significant improvements in area and power, compared to traditional synthesis approaches. In order to improve performance and efficiency, the results emphasize how crucial it is to take these strategies into account when designing and optimizing digital circuits.

articleTitle: STATCOM Performance Analysis with a Fuzzy-PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper presents a relative learn of a fuzzy logic-based STATCOM achievement to progress the not unsuitability of low-voltage operation with a grid-connected wind farm DFIG, and a evaluation with not activist STATCOM devices. The projected FLC-based STATCOM technique was simulated with MATLAB/Simulink. Consider the production impedance for voltages, currents, speeds, not active control, also not deliberate control of not individually the stator and rotor of the two systems under study through a network breakdown. STATCOM through Fuzzy-PI controller used for high-speed recovery, adaptive velocity and smooth current. Provides perfect presentation with. circuit and more reliable than traditional controller.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Overview of advancing Radio over Fiber (RoF) technology: Challenges, Solutions Strategies for Future Prospects for High-Performance Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Radio over Fiber (RoF) technologies emerge as a prominent alternative for Upcoming broadband distribution, connection, and efficient combined networks, meeting the rising need for Audio-Visual content with the assured level of assistance. With RoF technology, the adaptability and mobility of wireless networks are combined with the high capacity of optical networks. It has a number of benefits, such as less complexity at the antenna site, less expensive access network construction, flexible distribution of radio waves among antenna places, accessibility, and sustainability. However, a number of obstacles prevent RoF communication networks from reaching their full potential. This paper presents a review of these issues, such as signal degradation, nonlinearities, dispersion effects, and phase noise. Furthermore, it explores various mitigation techniques, including advanced modulation schemes, linearization methods, and dispersion compensation, to enhance the performance of RoF links. By addressing these challenges, the paper aims to pave the way for the realization of robust and efficient RoF communication networks.

articleTitle: Efficient Marine Fish Classification Using Hybrid Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing practices threaten marine ecosystems, global seafood supplies, and local livelihoods. Unscientific small-scale fisheries in biodiversity hotspots have a significant impact if it is not constrained to catch the size of fish. The computer vision technique has shown that it can process real-time images to monitor and assist humans in various applications. In this study, an experiment conducted on the Nature Conservancy Fish Dataset (NCFM dataset), contains images of 7 fish species. Hybrid deep learning based on YOLOv5 and ResNet152 was used for the efficient classification of different fish species. The proposed system achieved a Mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.93 on YOLOv5 for detection and an F1 score of 0.98 on ResNet152 for the classification of fish species.

articleTitle: Transformative Insights: Gabor Features and Tensor-EWT for COVID Diagnosis in Lung CT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The 2019 outbreak of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19) significantly affected the advancement of the global economy and the quality of life for people This paper addresses the limitations of traditional and trending tools in accurately and promptly detecting COVID through CT images, considering the highly contagious and dangerous nature of the illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Therefore, the paper focuses on developing a solution that automatically detects COVID. The novel approach is based on the Tensor-Empirical Wavelet Transform (TEWT), which is proposed to decompose diagnosed pre-processed images. Significant Gabor-based features are extracted from decomposed sub-band images, and relevant features are recognized using Neighborhood Component Analysis (NCA). Then, robust features are ranked using the Student's t-value algorithm, and ranked features are fed into LS-SVM for classification. The model achieved an impressive 96.29% increase in classification accuracy, improvements of 96.56% in specificity, 96.03% in sensitivity, and an F1 score of 95% using 5-fold cross-validation. The study's outcome is to demonstrate that the model exhibits state-of-the-art COVID classification techniques.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Machine Learning Framework for Heart Disease, Hypertension, and Diabetes Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: There are more illnesses every day, and detection takes too long. Nowadays, unhealthy lifestyles, junk food, and poor habits lead to many issues and potentially fatal illnesses. Following the COVID-19 pandemic in India, illness outbreaks such as heart disease, diabetes, and hypertension have impacted individuals globally. Currently, these illnesses are the leading cause of mortality for all ages. The health industry needs to improve illness prediction using Machine Learning (ML) approaches. Machine Learning (ML) within Artificial intellect may mimic human intellect and handle enormous amounts of data. Machine Learning single classifiers are insufficient for accurate and efficient classification nowadays. Hybrid Machine Learning Models are used to combine several classifiers. Prior study compared classifier ensembles for disease prediction. No universal model was created for varied illnesses. In the Covid-19 epidemic, people with hypertension, heart, or diabetes had a poor survival rate and were the main cause of mortality. Classifiers may classify or forecast illnesses. By using historical data, we were able to make predictions for cardiovascular condition, diabetes, and high blood pressure by using the Hybrid Ensemble Common Model. Using LightGBM, Random Forest, and KNN as Ensemble Classifiers, the Voting classifier is utilised for final output. The final output is captured after cross-validation.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Simulating of a Single-Phase Multi-Level Inverter with Reduced Device Count
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: These days, inverters are used to optimize output voltage and current control. That strong semiconductor device can lower harmonics and generate a high output voltage. Switching purpose we using the different reference voltages. This work's first section covers single-phase, seven-level inverters. We were able to construct seven-level, three-phase inverters with their help. The set of switches used to control the DC supply's output voltage with different voltage levels. Using the 1-phase multi level 7-level inverter output, we turn to 3-phase inverter. Outcome is contrasted with a grid-connected, traditional single-phase, seven-level PV inverter. This paper also results in reduced losses due to THD and EMI. THD decreases to 17%

articleTitle: OCT Image Classification Using CNN With Hybrid Feature Extraction Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: As seen by the current graph, the number of diabetes patients is rising steadily. It now serves as a logical research platform. The most recent study disproved Diabetes Mellitus’s in the growing diabetic macular edema (DME).In this paper, we have aimed to cut down on operation time and boost operational effectiveness. Operating on clusters of hybrid approaches accomplishes this. Discrete wavelet transformations and the fast Fourier transform have thus been utilized in this instance, and the classification method used is the convolution neural network (CNN). Using two significant topographies for community (kaggle) datasets, the intended technique generated correctness of 98.46%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Public Safety: Real-Time Weapon Detection through Deep Learning using YOLOv9
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Deep learning is an Artificial Intelligence technique which allows the system to learn from the data. One type of artificial neural networks used for image recognition and processing is a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which can extract patterns within the images. The challenge is real-time threat identification and response to threats in public spaces such as ATM booths and societies, as traditional surveillance systems depend on human monitoring that can lead to late reactions and oversight. Our solution is a software add-on that scans live CCTV footage in real-time to identify visible weapons. If it locates weapons in the footage, an alarm goes on or a message is sent providing full details of firearms found as described by them to its closest police station. The software works on becoming more accurate and faster. Two different models are trained on two different datasets which produced an accuracy of 92% and 97% respectively. This model is designed to get faster response and eliminate potentially dangerous situations providing a smooth and effective upgrade to existing surveillance systems, which guarantees continued advancement in threat prevention. Bringing an advanced level of security to the masses, this model has a user-friendly interface and can seamlessly mesh with already placed systems. It is simple for clients utilizing coexisting networked encryption facilities.

articleTitle: QoS-Driven Cluster Head Selection Optimization in Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The Internet of Things has a inclusive range of requests, counting, but not incomplete to, the management of transportation, the monitoring of health, technology, cities, residences, target tracking, and routing. These Internet of Things applications are made feasible as a result of the implementation of sensor nodes, which continuously monitor the entities and surroundings in the region around them, gathering and transmitting the data that is perceived in accordance with the requirements of the Internet of Things application. Evaluations of the Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH), the Three-Layered LEACH (TL-LEACH) procedure, and the Heterogeneous-LEACH (LEACH-HPR) protocols. A self-organizing clustering method known as LEACH is responsible for distributing energy consumption among the sensors that are part of the network. Within the framework of this technique, the sensors are established into local networks. For the purpose of improving LEACH, the TL-LEACH protocol makes use of the Power-Efficient Gathering in Sensor Information Systems (PEGASIS) protocols idea. It was the notion behind this that select CH nodes may have complex hardware or extra energy from a battery incorporated into them, which would result in a reduction in the total cost of the overall network infrastructure. The conclusions specify that the LEACH-HPR technique achieves a higher level of performance associated to both the LEACH and TL-LEACH procedures. LEACH-HPR maintains node performance with 96.5% accuracy, retaining a substantial number of active nodes. LEACH-HPR has a minor accuracy boost over LEACH and TL-LEACH, but it is energy efficient, extending node lifetime.

articleTitle: High Density SRAM for Drone Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A balanced and optimized processor for cache storage design significantly utilizes the carbon nanotube field effect transistors (CNFETs) static random access memory (SRAM) cells. A typical 6T CNFETS SRAM cell usually exhibits greater energy loss and latency. The purpose of the GNRFET 6T and 8T structures is to lower the overall power consumption and the static power consumption. However, the CNFETs 6T and 8T cells use more space and have less stability due to the more transistors. To solve these issues, the new 5T CNFETS SRAM cell have been suggested. As compared to the conventional 6T, CNFETs 6T, and 8T cells, the suggested cell uses 1.7×, 1.2×, and 1.4× less space, correspondingly. In comparison to 6T, CNFETs 6T, and 8T, the suggested 5T cell's total power consumption is reduced by 1.9×, 1.86×, and 1.84×, correspondingly. In a similar vein, the suggested cell's static power loss is decreased in comparison to conventional 6T, CNFETs 6T, and 8T by 1.75×, 1.49×, and 1.7×, correspondingly. As compared to conventional 6T, CNFETs 6T, and Si-CMOS 8T, the delay has increased by 1.5×, 1.48×, and 1.43×, correspondingly. The suggested cell has a comparable significant improvement in stability. To verify the deviation, a Monte Carlo (MC) simulation for the suggested cell with changes to the process was performed.

articleTitle: Optimizing Compressed Sensing with Taylor Sunflower Algorithm: A Performance Analysis of Hybrid Techniques for Biomedical Imaging and Video Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A powerful area that seeks to minimize the amount of space of signals that are compressible or sparse in a specific base representation that uses compressed recognizing in video streaming applications. A sparse signal provides a good approximation of the signal since the representation is sparse and the amplitude of the coefficient’s decays according to the power law. The process of projecting signals into a space with low dimensions results in measurement vectors. A sparse signal may be accurately reconstructed using the measurement vector. Imprecise or noisy data that may nevertheless be compressed and used for approximation purposes. Images in the frequency or wavelet domain are suitable for Compressed Sensing because they are inherently compressible. Reconstructed images are of higher quality, and the compression ratio—the ratio of an image's pixel count to its measurement vector—has been reduced, enabling more precise reconstruction. Taylor SFO based CS is a two-stage optimization technique for picture compression and recovery that aims to enhance the quality of models with high correlation and low redundancy. An image that uses self-replication and 3D change to compress itself is first processed in the early phase. In the last step, the CS uses SSIM to recover pictures using an ensemble sparseness estimate and Taylor SFO parameters.

articleTitle: Static Synchronous Compensator Using Fuzzy-PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In order to progress the low voltage journey through capabilities of a grid-connected DFIG based wind sheep farm, this paper present a learning of fuzzy logic control-based STATCOM devices and compares them with traditional STATCOM devices. The future FLC-based STATCOM device will be measured through Simulink with MATLAB. When comparing the output responses of the two systems under investigation—the stator and rotor—through grid faults, the STATCOM through fuzzy-PI controller performs greatest due to its earlier recovery time, changeable speed, smoother current profiles, along with higher level of reliability than the traditional controller.

articleTitle: Review of Machine Learning Techniques for Enhancing the Performance of OAM FSO Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In recent years, the advancement of Free Space Optical (FSO) communication systems has significant attention due to their potential for high-speed data transmission. This review examines the integration of ma-chine learning techniques in enhancing the performance and reliability of Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) FSO systems. By machine learning (ML) algorithms, these systems can effectively mitigate challenges such as atmospheric turbulence, alignment issues, and signal attenuation. The paper highlights various ML methodologies employed in FSO systems, including supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning approaches. It also discusses the comparative advantages of these techniques in optimizing signal quality, reducing error rates, and improving overall system efficiency. Through an in-depth analysis of current research and developments, this review provides insights into the future directions in the field of FSO communications facilitated by ML techniques.

articleTitle: A Novel Lightweight Block Cipher for Robust Data Protection in IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Due to the weak processing power and energy constraint associated with IoT devices, Data security and privacy are major issues enormously important for the growing environment of IoT. Cryptographic method is incompatible with the Internet of Things (IoT) as this concept is characterized by too high resource demand. In this work, a new lightweight block cypher, designed for the IoT devices is introduced which is supposed to provide proper protection to the data. There are advantages of the suggested cypher that reduces computational time, energy requirements and memory usage while promoting efficiency as well as high security. In order to avoid usual cryptographic attacks such as differential and linear, the cipher employs advanced encryption techniques together with an enhanced key scheduling mechanism. It is stated from experiments that the cypher is suitable for the implementation in energy-constrained IoT networks based on the fact that it attains an equilibrium between efficiency, security, and energy conservation. This work enhances data protection in IoT applications significantly but affords devices with limited power to avoid operating slower.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Modular 5-Level Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The modular multilevel (MML) converter has become the most promising converter technology for high power applications. A MML converter has several advantages over an H-bridge multi-level converter, including the ability to scale voltage and current, the lack of a transformer, the capacity to block faults, lower filter sizes, reduced output current ripple, high efficiency, and low redundancy costs. This research presents the modular 5-level converter (M5LC) and analyses its results to verify the converter's functionality.

articleTitle: Autism Spectrum Disorder Analysis Using Different Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: ASD (autism spectrum disorder) affects how people communicate, socialize, and behave. It usually starts showing up in childhood but can affect people of any age. While ASD can't be cured completely, early detection and intervention can help manage its symptoms effectively, Spotting ASD early can be tough because its symptoms vary and can be similar to those of other mental health issues. Advanced technology like deep learning and different machine learning algorithms can assist doctors in diagnosing ASD more accurately. In our study, we analyse different algorithm and suggest using support vector classifier and analyse lots of different features and figure out the most important ones for predicting ASD early on. This algorithm will make best predictions and more accurate. Finding ASD early is really important for improving how patients do so that they don’t have to suffer more later and saving money in healthcare. Machine learning methods have shown promise in predicting autism by looking at complicated data patterns and figuring out risk factors. By using data from various websites and analysing and thinking about various categories on which evaluation can be done, we can make better models for predicting autism in any age group of people.

articleTitle: Review: Analysis of Ternary Multiplier using CNTFET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: During the fullerene property in 1985, carbon nanotube in 1991 and Graphene in 2004, the carbon based nanomaterials have an enormous application in industrial sector. Fullerene is a type of carbon allotrope that are made up of carbon atoms that are linked together to form a closed or partially closed mesh. Carbon Nano Tube is an emerging technology achieving attention in recent times because of their properties like strength, flexibility, conductivity etc. The application of Carbon nanotube including in Engineering, Agriculture and in Medical fields. This review describes an Analysis of Ternary Multiplier using CNTFET which is far better than traditional FET.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Personal Desktop Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The purpose of developing technical AI is enabling realistic human-machine transmission. Various IT-based organizations used conversation networks technology to construct different types of Virtual A.I Assistants like Alexa, Cortana, Google Assistant, and Siri aim to enhance human-machine interaction. Our virtual assistant, modelled after Microsoft’s ‘Cortana’ voice assistant, uses Python may be used to complete simple tasks on the Windows System. It is used as a scripting language because of its wide library of command execution functions. Python packages enable the creation of personalized virtual assistants that recognize and process the user’s voice.
