Voice assistants represent a significant advancement in AI, with the potential to enhance people’s lives in various ways. Originally introduced on cell phones, these voice-based assistants quickly gained popularity. Everyone acknowledged it. Voice assistants have diversified after smartphones and computers to include smart speakers and home automation settings. As technology advances, it is capable of interaction with people using basic language. Desktop voice assistants recognize and respond to speech using integrated system. This will explain how voice assistants’ function, including its main issues and limitations. This analyses how to create a voice-based assistant that does not depend on cloud services, which will boost the future expansion of such gadgets.

articleTitle: A Study of Signal Processing Techniques in Power Quality disturbance detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The power quality of the power system is disturbed due to many nonlinear connected loads, switching of the power electronic devices, and uncertainties of the faults. Due to disturbances of power quality, the value of rated voltage and current is not supplied to the daily used equipment. So when the power quality is disturbed, the life and efficiency of the equipment used by consumers decrease. If the power quality of the system is good, the system will be more reliable, losses will be minimized, and overall efficiency will increase. This article studies various signal processing techniques that use time-domain, frequency-domain, and time-frequency domain methods for the detection of power quality issues. Furthermore, this study discussed advanced techniques like WT, STFT, etc. Next, this article discussed a comparative analysis of the various signal processing techniques.

Author Keywords: STFT(Short-Time Fourier Transform) and Wavelet Transfor

articleTitle: Review of Shadow Recognition and Mitigation Approaches in Various Fields of Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Information from the high-resolution satellite images can be extracted much more efficiently of present shadows of the objects or clouds from those images can be detected and removed. These shadow regions cause loss of information and sometimes get mixed with the darker objects. There are so many techniques are there in the present context related to the shadow identification with elimination, some are based on based on the geometric calculations and some are based on the property based. It is hard to detect the shadows from the geometrical approaches rather than the property based, as different geometric configurations are different for different types of location of images. For instance, an RGB and aerial image will have different properties rather than the color correction, in Multispectral images, there were be the information related to their thermal properties. In this review paper various methods related to shadow detection and correction are elaborated. Approaches are different and varies according to the applications. Some approaches are related to the applications of urban mapping and some related to the object tracking and image pixel ratios.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sentiment Analysis on US-Based Twitter Data through Stemming in Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a branch of Natural Language Processing which has been utilized by the organization and industries to identify the sentiments for the services and products. Sentiment analysis processed the textual data and convert semantics to identify the sentiment by dividing into three classes which are positive, negative and neutral. Here in this work, sentiment analysis has been examined using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) on twitter dataset. The data is preprocessed to convert into root words through the process of stemming for linguistic normalization and then into one-hot encoding, and embedding. The sentiment has been predicted using LSTM and the architecture has been systematically outlined with the precise value of the dropout layers to prevent the overfitting. The dataset features US airline tweets and addresses the real-world challenge of class imbalance in sentiment analysis. The model provides the robust training metrics, achieving an accuracy of 97.47%.

articleTitle: Real-Time Wildfire Detection Using ResNet50V2
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This research provides a convolutional neural network (CNN) model for feature recognition between real and bogus ones. The model was trained across ten epochs with a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 0.001. The design includes many convolutional layers after pooling layers and activation functions (ReLU) to aid in feature extraction. Flexibility of the model was improved by use of data augmentation methodologies. The training approach includes 2,278 photographs for validation and a set of 6,799 images for training. On the validation set, the model demonstrated to be 98.5% accurate, thereby proving its capacity to distinguish between true and spurious attributes. The end loss evaluated at 0.05 reflects a well-fitted model since the loss throughout training fell considerably. These results illustrate how successfully CNNs might manage face classification.

articleTitle: Combining Principal Component Analysis and Template Matching for Effective EEG Signal Classification in Seizure Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: EEG is routinely used in the assessment of the neurological patient’s state, especially in identifying the episodes of seizure in cases of epilepsy. However, the classification of the training signals into item classes is not always accurate because of the fact that they are based on EEG signals and the data is high dimensionality and complexity. This research work develops an original algorithm incorporating the PCA and template matching models for accurate EEG indicator organization in seizure recognition. PCA is used to transform the EEG signals into a space where relevant features are retained, and noise is minimized. Then, the signals are classified by using template matching technique with seizure and non-seizure templates. The integration of these two methods improves the detection performance and reduces the computational time when analysing a large amount of seizure data as shown from the experimental outcomes using benchmark EEG data. The approach proposed here has potential for real time seizure monitoring and can provide potential avenue towards enhanced clinical diagnosis and patient care.

articleTitle: 5G Launch: The Impact of Electronic Magnetic Radiations and Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: With launching of fully functional fifth-generation (5G) networks and smartphone manufacturers following suit with 5G-capable devices. While it will be years 5G becomes the global industry standard, it is critical to understand what this new era of technology entails and potential issues that may arise. Disadvantage of these waves is that they do not pass through structures as well as earlier lower frequency waves did. To combat this, telecommunications companies are building a denser network of smaller cells, resulting in a greater number of cells. This paper discusses how electromagnetic interference (EMI) can cause problems with electronic devices, equipment, and consumer electronics. In order to guarantee that an electronic device won't be harmed by outside electromagnetic waves, design and manufacturing processes must adhere to electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) standards, which are covered in this paper as well. Beyond that, it can't harm people's health or interfere with other devices.

articleTitle: A 19-Level Asymmetric Inverter with Fewer Switches to Lower Harmonic Distortion in Renewable Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: As inverters were extended to numerous layers to reduce distortion from the fundamental sinusoidal waveform, the concept of a multilayer inverter was born. Employing multiple-level inverters has the disadvantage of necessitating the installation of more switches, increasing system bulk and expense and decreasing system dependability because of the increased component count. The system is larger, more costly, less dependable, and has less distortion when compared to a symmetrical H-bridged nineteen-level inverter. This research addresses this problem by presenting a nineteen-level inverter (19-LI) with fewer switches in renewable sorces. The MATLAB platform is used to construct the concept, and analysis is done to ascertain how effective the end product is.

articleTitle: ML and Deep Learning for Diabetic Retinopathy Severity Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is known to be the major entanglement as a side-effect of diabetes. This disease majorly causes certain amount of injury of blood vessels in the area of retina. The extent of wound varies in magnitude that concludes the severeness of the disease. If DR is not predicted or treated on time, it may cause permanent loss in vision. Most recent studies prove that, computer aided diagnosis of retinal fundus images provides most promising and reliable outcomes. This paper compares the efficacy of traditional machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) architectures, including k-nearest neighbour (kNN) ML algorithm, vision transformers (ViT), ResNet50 and VGG16 DL algorithms for classification of diabetic retinopathy based on the severity of the disease. The paper has utilized a data set comprising five distinct classes ranging from mild to severe stages of the disease. Remarkably, the ViT emerges as the top performer surpassing other methods. The study offers promising avenues for the development of more accurate and efficient diagnostic tools for diabetic retinopathy assessment.

articleTitle: FS-GDI Technology-Based High-Performance Adder using CNTFETs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A superior functionality adder is one among the vital parts in the design of ASIC. Addition is an essential mathematical method and functions as a fundamental component that assembles all other procedures. As a result, it enables circuit designers to continue developing new models with enhanced features comprising versatility, productivity, endurance, and affordability. In the emerging invention, the Carbon Nanotube FET (CNTFET) is used in place of CMOS innovation for designing circuits. Whereby fully operational basic logic gates are used in the design of a superior functionality adder. By employing 32nm CNTFET Based FS-GDI Technology, the threshold voltage issue that frequently arises in Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) logic is resolved. The major objective of which is to give fast speed and low power consumption with complete voltage swing. Through HSPICE simulations utilizing 32 nm technology models, A comparison is made between the effectiveness of the proposed designs and different entire adder concepts, including CMOS, CPL, hybrid, and GDI. Discovered that the power-delay product (PDP), delay, power dissipation of current full adder cells had all improved.

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement of Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems Using Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: With the continuous increase in energy demand due to industrialization, environmental challenges such as global temperature rise and air pollution have become acute. Integrating renewable energy sources (RES) into the power grid offers a sustainable solution to these issues. Traditional passive methods, such as under/overvoltage and under/over-frequency techniques, can manage power imbalances between loads and distributed generation (DG), but they struggle to detect power quality issues when supply and consumption are balanced. This paper presents a new approach to optimize power quality(PQ) in hybrid renewable energy systems using fuzzy logic controllers(FLC), in combination with inverters and maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques. While RES are being rapidly adopted due to their stability, their output is highly variable depending on weather conditions, which can result in power quality challenges. The FLC dynamically adjusts the parameters of the inverter and MPPT based on real-time voltage and current inputs, ensuring that the system constantly operates at its maximum power point. The inverter converts the generated DC power to AC power, making it suitable for grid integration. Simulation results demonstrate that this method enhances power quality by reducing output fluctuations, leading to a more stable and reliable power supply. Moreover, the proposed approach is easy to implement and can be adapted to various renewable energy systems, significantly improving system stability, optimizing power quality and reducing harmonic distortion.

articleTitle: Enhancing Driver Safety through Convolutional Neural Networks for Drowsiness Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Driver drowsiness is a foremost reason for road accidents globally. This manuscript presents a driver drowsiness detection system using CNN, utilizing in-car camera video input to assess drowsiness levels. The system includes three main stages: face detection, landmark extraction, and classification. In the first stage, the face recognition algorithm detects the face of the driver from the video feed. In the second stage, landmark extraction is performed to detect and locate the facial landmarks. In the final step, CNN is used to classify facial features. This approach provides a unique and innovative solution that overcomes the limitations of existing methods that rely only on visual data. Using physiological signals such as EEG and EOG provides a more reliable and accurate measure of drowsiness levels, as these signals are directly related to the driver's brain activity and eye movement. Furthermore, the proposed methodology includes a real-time implementation that can provide drivers with alerts and warnings when drowsiness levels reach a dangerous threshold. This feature enhances road safety by preventing accidents resulting from driver drowsiness. The proposed system has been trained and tested on a dataset of drivers with different levels of drowsiness. The results show promising outcomes in detecting drowsiness with an accuracy of 92.25%. The proposed system can be unified into the existing vehicle structures to alert drivers when they become drowsy, reducing the risk of accidents on the road.

articleTitle: Robotic Recon: A Robotic Solution for Risky Operations and Explosive Neutralization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work presents an innovative and safety efficient solution specially designed for high-risk environments, where human intervention can be lethal — The Advanced Spying & Bomb Disposal Robot. A robotic arm and car combo allow for remote operation in environments where manual human operation can be dangerous. It has a night vision camera so robots can monitor and record in real time, even at night. Through a radio frequency (RF) remote controller, the system allows to control the movements of the robotic vehicle—forward, reverse and lateral—and facilitates changing orientations of objects through its robotic arm as well. This completely amped up, adjustable tripod head is reminiscent of a simple push-button interface which is easy to operate and precise in situations where fast adaptability is needed. 8051 microcontroller form the heart of the system which enables communication to be established between transmitting and receiving circuits. This highlights the strides made in robotics, remote operations and the potential to minimize risk to soldiers in military or emergency response situations. The proposed model lays the groundwork for future enhancements in the robot's autonomy, making it better suited to be a key tool in war and disaster management.

articleTitle: Optimizing Hybrid Sparse and Block-Based Compressed Sensing: A Performance Study for Biomedical Imaging and Video Surveillance Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: One of the most promising fields, compressed sensing has found a home in video streaming applications, where it seeks to compress or sparsely represent signals by reducing their dimensions. The sparse representation is a good approximation to the signal since the amplitude of the coefficient’s decays according to the power law. Signals are projected into low-dimensional space to generate measurement vectors. A sparse signal may be accurately rebuilt using the measurement vector. Signals or noise that are not sparse but can be compressed and might result in an approximation. Images in the frequency or wavelet domain are ideal for Compressed Sensing because they are compressible by nature. A more precise reconstruction of the original picture is possible due to an improvement in reconstructed image quality and a reduction in the compression ratio, which is the ratio of the dimensions of the number of pixels to the measurement vector.Hybrid Sparse and Block-based Compressed Sensing Algorithm (HSBCA) is the name of the approach that merged sparse-based and block-based compressed sensing algorithms. Block Compressed Sensing, the first module of HSSBCA, processes each message by dividing it into numerous picture regions, which results in decreased run time. In contrast, performance drops while picture reconstruction is underway; to remedy this, the research employs the second module, the sparse compressed sensing method, to boost reconstruction efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study on Deepfake Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The continued development of deepfake Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have generated much controversy within the multiple fields including politics, entertainment, and healthcare. Deepfakes cause the generation of highly convincing fake news to spread with the aim of influencing public opinions, and given that the pictures are near realistic and the sound quality is excellent, it gets hard to differentiate between original and fake content. The release of apps for creating deepfakes has greatly increased the need to find ways to mitigate them because the consequences are criminal on the levels of fake news and privacy infringement. For instance, deepfake technology is capable of manipulating political messages, deceiving the electorate, and inaccurately portraying diseases with likelyhoods of wrong diagnosis and subsequent wrong treatment. This present paper presents a comprehensive survey and analysis of the existing deepfake detection methods including the traditional machine learning techniques, state of the art deep learning methods, and the recent approach based on blockchain technology. Unlike some previous literature reviews that may only include new literature from the last few years, this research synthesizes results from more recent findings to explicate system limitations and recent developments. The presented research is designed to provide methodological approaches and findings to the discussion on deepfake detection to facilitate further empirical work and practical developments beneficial for the crucial field. For deepfake technology lies on the path of digital media’s continuous growth, therefore critical detection methods must be enhanced and united to maintain the desired information’s purity and shield society against potential risks.

articleTitle: Advanced Robotic Hand for Safe Handling of Medical and Sanitary Waste
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The management of medical and sanitary waste is essential in healthcare. This study presents a robotic hand for hygienic medical waste handling, utilizing 3D printing, Bluetooth control, and Arduino automation. This device reduces human exposure to hazardous materials, enhancing safety and efficiency. The hand's 3D-printed design allows for precise customization for various waste types. Its modular design features compliant fingers for secure handling of sharps, disposables, and biohazards. Arduino controls the robotic movements and coordination. Sensors assess waste type and weight, ensuring safe handling and spill prevention. Bluetooth functionality allows for remote operation, promoting ergonomic use for staff. Safety is prioritized with anti-slip features, collision detection, and failsafe systems. The modularity ensures ease of maintenance and component replacement. Testing in simulated scenarios confirmed its effectiveness, enhancing safety and reducing exposure risks. The Bluetooth control enhances usability, ensuring intuitive operation. This robotic hand provides a viable solution for medical waste management, addressing industry challenges. The integration of advanced technologies signifies a notable advancement in safety and infection control practices.

articleTitle: Industrial informatics in optimizing software-defined vehicles for logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Integration of industrial informatics and software-defined vehicle optimization is revolutionizing logistics. This study discusses how this integration may improve logistics safety, sustainability, and efficiency. Logistics are the backbone of international companies; thus, they must run smoothly. Industrial informatics and optimization studies yielded new findings. This powerful technology combines advanced machine learning algorithms, data analytics, and real-time monitoring to change logistics. Data-driven decisions are the foundation of industrial informatics. This research determines the best data analytics methods for gas and labor savings. Real-time monitoring keeps logistical operations adaptive to changing circumstances, while predictive maintenance and energy-efficient driving boost system efficiency. Nearest Neighbor, Branch and Bound, Particle Swarm Optimization, Monte Carlo Simulation, and Genetic Algorithms reveal that the suggested technique is superior. This study shows the indicated approach's considerable effect. Its cheaper pricing, faster delivery, and lesser carbon emissions make it better than conventional solutions. Logistics operations are safer with the proposed method, which has a higher safety score and fewer accidents and incidents. The suggested method benefits from its flexibility, scalability, and adaptability, which are crucial in a fast-changing firm. Expense savings: Save $250,000 using the proposed technique. The new method results in a time savings of 15.79%. The suggested approach reduces carbon emissions by 3,000 kg (26.09%). The suggested method improves safety ratings by 10—11.36%.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach Using Spider Monkey and Tiered Particle Swarm Optimization for IoT Disturbance Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A network of interconnected computing devices, sensors, and other electronic devices that can conversation and process information is known as the IoT. Devices on the network that have unique IP addresses may communicate with one another and with the outside world over the internet. The idea of the IoT has grown in significance because intelligent environments, including smart homes and cities, have been developed. These environments include a wide range of application disciplines. Aiming to make every day human activities more creative and competitive, such smart settings address concerns with living conditions, industrial demands, and energy usage. With the proliferation of IoT services and apps across many networks, the primary objective is now obvious. This study presented SMO-HPSO to improve identification accuracy while decreasing false alarm levels, and to lever the enormous quantity of intrusion statistics classification problems. In addition, the Random Forest Classifier (RFC) is used to find the best values for attack categorization using the UNSW NB-15 and NSL-KDD datasets. Current approaches such as RFC, DT, and SVM were contrasted with the suggested SMO-HPSO method. When tested against other algorithms, SMO-HPSO outperformed them on the NSL-KDD and UNSW NB-15 datasets. Positive outcomes, including enhanced efficiency in attack detection and categorization, have been shown by the suggested models.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Various Brain Activity Recognition Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Brain Computer Interface (BCI) is the interaction of the human brain with the machinery based on brain activity for communication process. It arose as part of a neurological action induced by muscular or cognitive operations in the brain. These activities create brain waves which are sent to a hardware device for the execution of the exact task. The BCI devices are used to record the brain responses by using the diverse invasive and non-invasive acquisition techniques Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Electrocorticography (ECoG), Magnetoencephalography (MEG), and Electroencephalography (EEG). This work provides a survey on brain activity using EEG signals. The Deep learning (DL) and the Machine Learning (ML) are the pattern recognition techniques for transforming the brain responses for managing several applications. The present paper discusses the merits, existing development and demerits of BCI. Ultimately, the experimental results at every BCI stage are analysed at last. Though there exist many techniques, only 25 research articles concerted on BCI are considered here. At last, the examination is supported on the basis of performance measures, technique used, year of publication and achievements.

articleTitle: Exploring Consumers’ Purchase Intention on Energy effective Home Appliances
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: People's propensity or desire to purchase home appliances that are made to consume as little energy as possible. Concerns about the environment, resource conservation, and lowering carbon footprints make it imperative that consumers purchase home appliances. Using efficient energy appliances reduces the effects of climate change, promotes energy conservation, and is consistent with sustainable living. It is vital for both individual households and the larger social energy environment because it handles rising energy bills and improves energy security. To determine customer preferences, awareness, and barriers, traditional techniques use surveys, interviews, and observational studies. Crucial elements impacting purchase intentions have been identified through the use of statistical approaches like regression analysis. These methods could also be shallow in their comprehension of the underlying motives that influence the decisions made by customers. This study uses the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), a structural equation modelling (SEM) paradigm, to address these issues. By combining psychological concepts including attitudes, subjective standards, and apparent behavioural control, the TPB offers a explanation of how consumers choose energy effective home equipment. When compared to previous models, the proposed TFB model fit better (CFI=0.992, RMSEA=0.023), demonstrating its effectiveness in describing customers' intents to purchase energy effective home equipment.

articleTitle: Traffic-Aware Secure Routing Protocol with Reliable Authentication and Integrity Techniques for WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are very significant in several fields owing to their efficient data collection capabilities from the physical environment. Ensuring the security as well as accuracy of gathering and transmitting data in WSNs is a crucial topic. To elaborate, relying on the existing information, conventional routing protocols such as FAEM, NPBNS, NSSR have been employed by Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) for data transfer. The flaw with FAEM is that the throughput is unable to sustain high rates whenever the status of the network has been altered. undefined It has also been disclosed that while both routers have experienced an enhanced throughputs via NPBNS and NSSR, the latter boasted more effective routing algorithms, prompting an appreciably higher performance recognition for NSSR. As concerning IT services in the total, the differences were identified to compare NSSR with RITASR where NSSR IT services are 98% less than RITASR. achieves 7% accuracy in relation to sustaining consistent throughput, something NSSR itself only has a 97. undefined From this, it can be inferred that there has been a rise by 1. However, it is more important to mention here is that it is proportional to the increase of the throughput accuracy of 5%. For this reason, RITASR is a communication protocol that can be conveniently applied in WSNs. Same to this, the traffic management and security aspects of RITASR are also enhanced to provide an overall performance gain of 15 percent on the network.

articleTitle: Diving into the World of Tensors and Exploring the Truths of Topological Data Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The rapid expansion of data analysis depends on breakthroughs in tensor and topological data structure investigation. This study presents a new approach that leverages persistent homology, geometric deep learning, and tensor decomposi-tion to extract usable information from topologically complex, high-dimensional datasets. We describe the proposed idea and thoroughly test it against six alterna-tive possibilities. Several key features reveal that the proposed strategy outperforms current methods. These include processing efficiency, accuracy, scalability, robustness, interpretability, and application performance. Machine learning, topo-logical data analysis, and tensor decomposition can reveal hidden data patterns. We demonstrate how the technique simplifies many datasets, making it an excel-lent alternative for data exploration in numerous fields. Our investigation reveals that the recommended technique can handle topological data structures and high-dimensional data, which previous methods have missed. This comprehensive strategy simplifies high-dimensional data search. Academics and data scientists have more powerful, versatile, and easy-to-understand tools to explore topologi-cal data structure complexity.

articleTitle: Advanced Feature Extraction from Retinal Color Fundus Images for Accurate Macular Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Image processing has been used in the field of biomedicine for quite some time, particularly for the purpose of diagnosing eye problems. When an individual has an eye ailment, the visual structure and smoothness of all of the layers of their retinas will be altered. A number of imaging devices, such as the Fundus their cameras, the Scanner Laser Ophthalmoscope (SLO), and the Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), have helped make it feasible to image and investigate several facets of the structure and functionality of the retina. Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is another illness that is prevalent among those who have glucose mellitus. In addition to haemorrhages, tiny arteries, and an abundance of both hard as well as soft exudates, it is characterised by arteries that are leaking and have an uneven form. There is a possibility that the blood arteries may burst, causing blood to spill into the retina. Additionally, it causes fluid to accumulate close to the macula, which results in a reduction in vision. Proliferative retinopathy due to diabetes is a more serious kind of the illness, whereby the veins that have been destroyed will become clogged, which will then lead to the abnormal development of fresh vessels that leak. When it comes to these disorders, early identification and management are very important, since they might otherwise result in blindness. Compared to competing approaches like VGG16, GoogleNet, Inception V3, and CSR, the suggested approach of segmenting optic discs and blood vessels segmentation has a 99% success rate. As a result, the suggested method outperforms the alternatives when it comes to processing retinal pictures properly.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis on EEG Signal Processing for BCI Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: An overview of the brain-computer interface is given in this publication and the variety of deep learning architectures for the acquisition of brain signals we have discussed the EEG signals that are used in BCI applications. Time-frequency localization is frequently poor in EEG signals. As a result, BCI systems frequently have low task detection accuracy and high error rates. It also exhibits extremely quasi qualities and has a lot of trans variances. Additionally, we have discussed noise removal techniques given by different researchers from EEG signals and BCI applications, and the comparison is given further than we have discussed regarding the EEG signal's image retrieval and different deep learning techniques for EEG learning commons. From the analysis of the results of different approaches, it’s been noticed that non-stationary EEG signals are more contributing to BCI applications. Whereas, in pre-processing steps, SWT-ICA, DWT, and CSP algorithms are most efficient for noise removal. For feature extraction sliding window spatial and temporal methods and deep learning methods contributed the most. Finally, for feature learning and classification, transfer learning and fine-tuned model performance were analyzed. It was observed from the analytical review that the fine-tuned transfer learning model outperforms better.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Antennas for 5G & Beyond: A Comprehensive Review of Advances, Challenges and Future Directions*
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study undertakes a critical review of the development and applications of metamaterial antennas in wireless communication systems, mainly targeting 5G and beyond. As the demand for more challenging requirements in faster data rates, higher bandwidth, and higher efficiency is constantly growing, conventional antenna technologies are often compromised by escalating demands. The traditional materials, with their refractive index mainly positive and sub-wavelength structures being very deep, could not manage the increasing demands for high degrees of performance in any fields. Consequently, metamaterials have refractive indices and possess further depths in sub-wavelength structuring. These artificial materials enable the design of antennas that not only are compact but also have better performance metrics, such as higher gain and broader bandwidths. This study elaborates on metamaterial antennas and their different configurations with a focus on applications in the improvement of MIMO and mmWave systems for 5G deployments. The following sections of the study talk about the distinguished benefits of metamaterial antennas, which involve device miniaturization with no degradation in performance, high radiation efficiency, and feasibility for massive MIMO configurations. Such properties qualify them to be an excellent choice for stringent technical requirements of 5G networks, such as latency reduction, high data throughput, and spectrum efficiency. It achieves incorporation with practical systems but with some hurdles. Some of the issues concerning the complexity of metamaterial structures, manufacturing difficulties, and significant production costs are also discussed. Lastly, paper closes with future directions in the field of metamaterial antenna research by highlighting the potential of newly emerging materials such as graphene and reconfigurable as well as tunable designs of metamaterial suitable for adaptable operating conditions.

articleTitle: Integrating Deep Learning to Decode Meningeal Interleukin-17 T Cell Mechanisms in Salt-Sensitive Hypertension-Induced Cognitive Decline
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study describes a complete strategy for training and refining CNN for picture classification. This approach uses several complicated methods. This approach incorporates fully linked decision-making layers, convolutional and pooling feature extraction layers, as well as learning rate modifications, momentum, regularization, and gradient cutting optimization techniques. The proposed technique uses a softmax output layer to create statistical predictions for each class and improve them via a loss function and backpropagation. Using cross-validation and test data to assess model performance and quitting early to minimize overfitting improves optimization. The recommended technique outperforms cutting-edge methods like deep convolutional neural networks (DCNN), transfer learning with CNN, and hybrid CNN-RNN in several performance tests. The approach has the best precision, recall, and F1 score and 92.5% model accuracy, indicating its effectiveness and balance. The strategy is successful and requires minimal training and logic. The method's high cross-validation scores and confusion matrix demonstrate its classification accuracy and suitability for various datasets. These findings demonstrate that the proposed strategy solves challenging photo sorting tasks well in the classroom and in real life.

articleTitle: Enhancing Kitchen Waste Composting with Black Soldier Fly Larvae: Integrating Life Cycle Assessment and CNN-GRU Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative approach to optimizing Black Soldier Fly Larvae composting by developing a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network-Gated Recurrent Unit model. The model leverages CNN's ability to extract spatial features, such as temperature and humidity, from the composting environment, and combines it with GRU's capacity to process temporal data, capturing the dynamic nature of the composting process. The dataset, sourced from Kaggle, includes detailed food waste data across households, retail, and food service sectors, providing a comprehensive basis for training and testing the model. To ensure consistent model performance, data preprocessing is performed using Min-Max Scaling, which standardizes the data for compatibility with the model’s architecture. The integration of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) outputs with the CNN-GRU model predictions offers a dual perspective by not only optimizing the composting process but also evaluating the environmental impact, including greenhouse gas emissions and resource use. The proposed CNN-GRU model demonstrates exceptional performance, achieving an accuracy of 98.7%, significantly surpassing traditional algorithms such as Random Forest, Artificial Neural Networks, and standard CNN models. This high level of accuracy underscores the model's effectiveness in predicting and optimizing BSFL composting outcomes. The entire framework has been implemented in Python, enabling robust and flexible deployment in various composting scenarios. This research presents a significant advancement in sustainable waste management practices, providing a powerful tool for optimizing BSFL composting while simultaneously assessing its environmental sustainability. The findings offer valuable insights and practical solutions for enhancing composting efficiency and environmental responsibility.

articleTitle: Automating Indian Railway Services: A Face Recognition-Based Approach to Queue Management and Ticket Booking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This research paper describes a prototype software model intended to improve the efficiency and security of the Indian Railways' ticket buying process, notably for customers travelling in general class. The study also gives a thorough examination of current solutions and their limitations. One notable issue found is the lack of a tracking system for local passengers in the general class, which causes inefficiencies and security issues. To solve this, the suggested approach uses face recognition technology to effectively manage lineups in the offline booking area. Furthermore, automation techniques are used to speed up formerly manual operations, resulting in increased total booking speed. The program keeps track of all passengers, providing a reliable system for tracking and security. This approach not only enhances the booking experience but also contributes to improved safety measures within the railway system.

articleTitle: Developments in the Application of Machine Learning Techniques for Mobile Ad-Hoc Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The self-configuring and decentralised network system basically known as Mobile Ad-hoc Networks or in short MANETs are essential for a number of applications, including smart cities, battlefield operations, disaster mitigation and many more. However, they are vulnerable to several security concerns, including routing-based attacks such as black hole and grey hole acts of terrorism, due to their dynamic topology, inherent lack of centralised management, and a lack of resources. The present review article explores the possible risks that multiple methods of machine learning may offer to MANETs and how they can be mitigated. This research looks at several attack strategies, classifies them as either external or internal, active or passive and evaluates the shortcomings of protection methods that are currently on the market. Going through various runs of evaluation and assessment of recent improvements in domains to study the advantages in addition to the drawbacks that applies algorithmic and deep machine learning (ML) strategies to enhance MANET security. Furthermore, the studies delves into innovative detection methods, such as using a mixture of algorithms and deep neural networks that assesses their impact through different scenarios at the same time as imparting an extensive review of gift improvements and potential future directions in MANET security.

articleTitle: Advanced Uses of Micro Electro Mechanical Systems-Based Devices in Healthcare and Robotics Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This research aims to provide affordable and accessible devices for elderly and physically handicapped individuals, addressing self-reliance and societal impact. Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) is a popular technology, but limited in India due to limited resources. Here primary aim is to create novel devices that can improve design and analysis efficiency. The proposed sensor will normalize mobility for wheelchair bound patients and find industrial applications in robotics. The project also focuses on developing wearable devices for gait detection and analyzing reliability, sensitivity, and device response. The research uses multi-physics concepts and FEM to design and analyze sensing materials for MEMS/BioMEMS-based devices. It also focuses on the development of high-sensitivity MEMS-based microstructure devices for gait detection in wheelchair-bound patients. The sensor can be used in industrial robotics and medical sectors. The study also aims to analyze the reliability, sensitivity, and device response of the MEMS-based device, which could be used for the diagnosis and treatment of gait-related diseases. The goal is to make this technology accessible to the elderly and physically handicapped, addressing various healthcare and environmental issues.

articleTitle: Neural network-based signal processing techniques for near-field acoustics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Near-field acoustics is spatially and temporally broad. This study investigates near-field acoustics neural network sound processing. The major goals are to develop novel signal processing methods and understand sound behavior near its source. Attention processes found complicated patterns, CNNs investigated space, and LSTM networks depicted temporal relationships. The recommended technique was compared to principal component analysis, hidden Markov models, wavelet transform, spectrum analysis, and non-negative matrix factorization. Results reveal that the recommended method is more accurate than current ones. Traditional methods scored 0.70–0.79, whereas the recommended approach scored 0.85. Modern approaches are accurate to 0.88, compared to 0.75–0.82. Finally, neural network-based signal processing in near-field acoustics may reveal sound behavior near its source. The proposed technology uses CNNs, LSTMs, and attention. It accurately captures near-field audio data's complicated temporal and spatial features. The comparison analysis found the recommended approach more accurate than traditional methods. It may help us understand near-field acoustics and its applications in industrial quality, noise reduction, location, and management.

articleTitle: A Probability-Based Routing Algorithm for Improved Message Transmission in Vehicular Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In Vehicular Social Networks (VSN), the high speed of vehicles and the unpredictability of their directions lead to constantly changing network topologies and frequent interruptions in communication links. As a result, there are high rates of message loss and transmission delays during message transmission. To address these issues, a probability-based routing algorithm (ProSim) for VSN is proposed, which utilizes opportunistic encounters between nodes for message transmission. The VSN routing algorithm is designed based on the social relationships between vehicles to mitigate the high loss rates and delays caused by communication link interruptions. It involves selecting the encounter probability and social similarity of vehicle nodes as social relationships, quantifying them, and calculating the transmission probability. Simulations using real road data show that ProSim, compared with three classic routing algorithms: Direct Delivery (DD), Epidemic, and PRoPHET, can effectively improve the message transmission rate while controlling transmission overhead and delay. Keywords: Vehicular Social Network; Opportunistic Communication; Social Relationships; Transmission Probability; Routing Algorithm.

articleTitle: Investigating The Potential of Self-Supervised Learning in Adversarial Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Machine learning has enabled innovative usage in numerous fields. These systems are vulnerable to hostile assaults. Small intentional alterations to misclassify data constitute a major security risk. We examine three solutions: "Self-Supervised Adversarial Defense," "Adversarial Mixup," and "Secure and Self-Supervised Learning." These strategies safeguard and protect machine learning models from other computers. We start our study with the theory underlying these approaches and how they are employed in machine learning. A detailed experimental evaluation utilizing a real-world dataset with difficult adversarial situations is shown. These approaches are tested using accuracy, precision, memory, F1 score, and ROC AUC. Results are certain. All indicators suggest that new methods outperform old ones. "Self-Supervised Adversarial Defense" is the most exact and precise, but "Adversarial Mixup" and "Secure and Self-Supervised Learning" are also useful, especially for memory. The ROC AUC values also demonstrate that the recommended approaches can distinguish positive and negative classes, which is crucial in binary classification problems. Finally, our work indicates that these strategies can make machine learning models safer and more resilient in harmful conditions. This study reveals how adversarial perturbations and self-supervised learning might solve the crucial challenge of adversarial assaults. These strategies can make machine learning systems safer, which might impact hacking, healthcare, and self-driving systems.

articleTitle: Innovative Integration of Machine Learning Predictive Models within Blockchain Frameworks for Supply Chain Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The study came up with a new way to make the supply chain more fault-tolerant by combining Machine Learning Predictive Models with Blockchain Frameworks (MLBH). This idea was put to the test against six common ways to handle problems in the supply chain. These are Lean Supply Chain Management, Supply Chain Risk Assessment, Demand Forecasting Models, Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI), and Inventory Optimization. We judged success by how well it could be scaled, how much money it saved, how accurate the predictions were, how open it was, and how much it couldn't be changed. It was clear that the MLBH method worked better. It turned out to be better than traditional methods in every way, such as being open, scalable, saving money, protecting data, not being able to be changed, and making accurate predictions. Businesses that want to improve their performance and return on investment (ROI) should think about the suggested method, which has been shown to make supply chains more resilient and efficient. The cost-benefit analysis showed that the suggested answer had a strong return on investment (ROI), even though it would require some upkeep and implementation costs.

articleTitle: Neural network approaches for enhancing near-field wireless power transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper looks at new developments in near-field wireless power transfer using a fresh method that aims to improve stability, efficiency, and long-term viability while testing and developing. Magnetic induction and resonant coupling are two common ways to send power over short distances, but they aren't always reliable or efficient. To solve these problems, we offer a full system that includes up-to-date signal processing techniques, the best antenna designs, and effective ways to reduce clutter. The study carefully compares the suggested method to well-known standards for things like power transfer efficiency, alignment errors, frequency stability, energy conversion efficiency, system dependability, and real-time adaptability. A study comparing different methods shows that the suggested method is more reliable and efficient, and it also lowers the number of alignment mistakes and running costs compared to other methods. The study also looks at problems of environmental impact and regulatory compliance, showing that the method meets both legal standards and has a beneficial effect on the environment. These features are crucial for making sure that wireless power transfer systems are legal and safe for the environment. The work includes an ablation study to split the roles of different parts in the suggested approach. This shows how important signal processing methods, antenna designs, and interference-reducing methods are for improving performance.

articleTitle: Advances in ECG Signal Processing for Arrhythmia Detection & Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Arrhythmia is abnormal electrical signal flow in heart muscles. Arrhythmias must be grouped appropriately to find cardiac issues. Patients can pick the best treatment after being notified they have a heartbeat early on. Identifying rhythms on an ECG might be difficult. Before creating an arrhythmia classification system, electrocardiogram (ECG) data must be processed and significant elements removed and improved. This paper discusses the issues that arise while cleaning up an ECG, removing undesirable characteristics, improving its performance, and categorizing it. Results evaluation procedures are also presented. The following few words discuss potential ECG denoising, feature extraction, classification uses and issues. This paper includes ECG data, feature extraction, noise reduction, and arrhythmia classification. Arrhythmia is difficult to treat and frequently remains undiagnosed. For patient care, early and accurate categorization and detection of arrhythmia are critical. Advances in deep learning are drawing more attention to the detection and categorization of arrhythmia. This assessment analyzes the literature on the identification and classification of arrhythmia using deep learning. The subject matter includes model structures, preprocessing, performance assessment, dataset properties, and future directions in research. The survey discusses the challenges and opportunities associated with deep learning's potential to improve arrhythmia diagnosis.

articleTitle: Reliable Anomaly Detection in Heterogeneous Cloud Data Using Chi-Square Feature Selection and RF Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The scalability and dependability offered by cloud infrastructure are important to the modernization of many services and businesses. Data storage and retrieval procedures like this have the potential to revolutionize many areas, including the human life cycle, business, education, and more. The term "intrusion detection" refers to the steps used to find instances of unauthorized access to cloud infrastructure that breaches established security protocols. Unauthorized acts may be more easily detected if the detection procedure is based on the assumptions about non-legitimate users' behaviours, which are more anomalous than usual. Because they are caught and dealt with before any harm comes to the system, these abnormalities are considered to contribute to its dependability. The machine learning algorithms work by analysing past data to make predictions about the future based on what the system has learned, which helps to identify inappropriate behavior. The suggested Random Forest (RF) classifier, which incorporates the ChiSquare algorithm framework, has been used for anomaly detection. This study employs the node selection method for efficient node selection and the Chi-Square technique for identifying the important characteristics for detection. This trustworthy source utilizes the cloud computing environment to identify abnormalities using this anomaly detection approach. Slave nodes do analytics in the same cloud. The workload is significantly decreased even though the node selection technique is used to determine the appropriate number of nodes.

articleTitle: Transforming Consumption and Production to Achieve Sustainable Development Patterns Through Innovations and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: For sustainable growth, we must modify how we consume and manufacture things, according to this research. A comprehensive framework incorporates circular economy optimization, green technology integration, sustainable sourcing algorithms, deep learning for predictive analytics, and AI-driven resource allocation. Starting with the importance of finding innovative approaches to handle challenging sustainability concerns. We also discuss how economic prosperity, environmental responsibility, and social responsibility delicately interact. This study thoroughly integrated eco-friendly strategies, including the cycle economy, green technologies, ethical shopping, predictive analytics, and AI-based resource allocation. The proposed solution uses many technologies to operate effectively and has been evaluated against established methods. A circular economy, green tools, sustainable sourcing, producer responsibility, and resource efficiency are examples. The results indicate that the proposed plan outperforms others in important areas. The proposed method scored 0.82 for economic efficiency, whereas earlier methods scored 0.70. The new technique rated 0.75 for environmental impacts, much higher than the prior 0.65. An average score of 0.80 for the proposed approach compared to 0.70 for standard procedures demonstrated that respondents were more concerned about social equality. The suggested strategy averaged 0.90 resource efficiency, compared to 0.75 for the others. In the changing world of sustainable development, flexibility is a critical component, and the recommended technique scored substantially higher than the usual ways (0.55 for each). In conclusion, the study reveals that we need to rethink production and consumption and that the offered strategy is acceptable and effective. The integrated structure outperforms prior methodologies and creates a more robust, adaptable, and equitable sustainable development strategy.

articleTitle: Predictive Resilience Framework for Energy Management Systems in Next-Generation Smart Grids Using a Hybrid LSTM-ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The Predictive Resilience Framework for Energy Management Systems in Next-Generation Smart Grids integrates advanced forecasting and modeling techniques to enhance grid stability and efficiency. This framework uses Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) network with AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) models as the backbone to make the accurate predictions and understanding the dynamics of the energy system. The use of ARIMA befits a number of time series forecasting requirements, which consists of identifying patterns based on past data, and mitigating non-stationary beliefs as load forecasting, renewable integration, fault identification, and demand response. On the other hand, LSTM networks are effective at modelling the long-term dependencies in the sequences hence enhancing the way the model produces future state from previous sequences. The hybrid LSTM-ARIMA approach merges the strengths of both models: ARIMA gives a stable framework on which to build the prediction and LSTM gives an improvement on these predictions due to its ability to deal with complex patterns and temporal attributes. This combination also helps fundamental predictive resilience by allowing for prevision of both energy demand and renewable production, standout of system abnormalities, and direction of peak loads and response programmes. Furthermore, the framework helps in analysing the ability of the grid to operate under various stress conditions such as weather conditions and cyber attacks. By including such superior modelling approaches the framework has been designed to enhance the utility of the grid, balance the energy provision and strengthen the general resource of the system to new threats and instability within the future and more complex smart grid systems.

articleTitle: Exploring Patterns and Evolving Paradigms Within Pristine Management Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The management discipline is always developing and evolving in response to new challenges in the corporate world. This study provides a thorough investigation of paradigm shifts and recurring themes in wilderness administration. To investigate both the past and present dynamics of management ideas and practices, the suggested technique integrates historical research with dynamic temporal warping, Markov models, and evolutionary algorithms. The suggested technique is compared to six existing approaches in terms of originality, flexibility, efficiency, sustainability, staff participation, and client satisfaction. The results show that the suggested technique is superior to the state-of-the-art approaches in every respect. Notably, it excels in novel approaches, flexibility, and efficiency, all of which point to its capacity to accommodate shifting management tenets. The suggested technique also performs better on the sustainability scale, highlighting its dedication to long-term viability and ethical standards. The findings stress the need of using data-driven, interdisciplinary strategies to comprehend and accommodate dynamic management procedures. The suggested strategy is useful for both academics and professionals in a world where flexibility and creativity are essential for business survival.

articleTitle: Machine Mentality and its Progression Through the Complexity of Mathematical Modules
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work examines how machine awareness has changed over time by examining mathematical module complexity using a new technique that combines historical study, real-world testing, and sophisticated machine learning algorithms. We can completely comprehend how mathematical complexity influences machine intelligence with the provided strategy. Our method begins with a detailed examination of AI's mathematical underpinnings' evolution. This historical perspective shows how arithmetic has affected robot thinking. Second, real-world trials evaluate machine learning and mathematical models. These approaches are evaluated on accuracy, precision, memory, F1 score, mean squared error, and computing efficiency. The comparison shows that the recommended strategy outperforms six well-known strategies that employ many criteria. Results show the proposed strategy works. Traditional approaches can't match its 95% accuracy. The approach is more beneficial than normal methods since it has superior accuracy, memory, and F1 scores. A smaller mean squared error indicates that the recommended strategy predicts better than current methods. Its 7.2 millisecond processing time makes it the most computing-efficient option. This unique methodology lets us understand how machine intelligence has evolved and choose the optimal solutions for particular occupations. The recommended technique is effective for studying the complex link between mathematical modules and AI progress since it incorporates historical background and cuttingedge algorithms.

articleTitle: Deep Learning's Insights into Toxicology and Drug Safety Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Toxicology and drug safety testing ensure drug and chemical safety and efficacy. Traditional approaches need a lot of testing, which may not reveal the complex relationships between chemical attributes and hazards. This article examines how deep learning, a kind of AI, may alleviate these chronic issues. Deep learning is ideal for complex, multidimensional data. Deep learning can discover subtle patterns in massive data sets. A new field of research emerges. It has improved toxin prediction and classification, improving public health and medicine safety. This lengthy research examined how deep learning systems handle chemical structures and biological testing. In toxicological and chemical safety investigations, deep learning models are examined. In the chemical and pharmaceutical sectors, product safety testing involves time and money and may not always be accurate. Deep learning may help you rapidly uncover challenging patterns to predict toxicity. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) analyze linear data and change toxicity data, whereas CNNs adapt to chemical structures. Transformers teach us about dangers. Data-driven deep learning can identify small relationships that large datasets can't. By detecting intoxication faster and more precisely, this might make drugs safer. Deep learning adds and displays features well. It learns rapidly from raw data how to do things well without features. This expertise is useful in poisoning when chemical properties are unclear. Deep learning uses attention mechanisms and feature representations to simplify data interpretation. You must grasp them to trust AI-based risk predictions and make sensible judgments. Deep learning in governance systems makes issues worse, including maintaining grade standards and correcting faults. Data security and smart AI safety are crucial.

articleTitle: Empirical Studies on Wearable WSNs in Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Our research study, "Wearable WSNs in Human Activity Recognition," describes a complete method for detecting human activity using wireless sensor networks and wearable devices. Gathering and processing data, extracting characteristics, and applying them are three techniques to identify movement. We test with several WSN-equipped persons. Our portable WSNs include accelerometers, gyroscopes, and heart rate monitors to collect and analyze data. Continuously filtering and altering raw sensor data prepares it for usage. Feature extraction is essential to interpret mixed sensor data. No more MAD or Fast Fourier Transform. We identify human behavior using Random Forest, K-NN, and LSTM Network techniques. Our WSN-HAR approach outperforms others in "Comparison of Recognition Metrics" and "Computational Efficiency and Energy Consumption" charts. Memory, F1-score, precision, accuracy, and processing time indicate system speed. The recommended approach computes swiftly and uses little power, making it suitable for energy-efficient programs.

articleTitle: Devising a Textual Analogous Computation-Centric Approach for Profiling Exercise Levels
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper introduces the Textual Analogous Computation-Centric Approach (TACCA) for textual data-based exercise level monitoring. TACCA uses natural language processing and machine learning to classify written exercise reports by difficulty to address concerns with smart devices and self-reported surveys. Semantic analysis and word embeddings extract textual characteristics. Machine learning algorithms use these properties to categorize exercise levels in a labelled dataset. Memory, accuracy, and Area Under the Curve (AUC) compare TACCA to standard research methods. The results show that TACCA accurately measures exercise intensity better than other methods. TACCA distinguishes exercise types and reduces classification mistakes with 0.85 accuracy, 0.87 precision, 0.83 recall, and 0.92 AUC. This research's ablation study separates TACCA's key components. It shows how powerful machine learning and semantic analysis raise performance standards. These results show that TACCA's general design approach works when components interact to improve prediction accuracy and flexibility. Healthcare systems may employ TACCA due to its fast and large processor. TACCA can handle large data sets and function in various healthcare situations, making it ideal for health and fitness monitoring.

articleTitle: RPA as a Catalyst for Agile Transformation in Software Development
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Agile methodologies have revolutionized software development by emphasizing flexibility, collaboration, and rapid iteration. Meanwhile, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) has emerged as a powerful tool for automating repetitive tasks across various industries. Integrating RPA into Agile frameworks promises enhanced efficiency, scalability, and quality assurance. This paper explores the intersection of Agile and RPA, highlighting how RPA can accelerate Agile transformations by automating manual processes and freeing up resources for innovation. Through a systematic review and case studies, this study identifies key benefits, challenges, and implementation strategies for leveraging RPA in Agile software development.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches to Predict Student Success in English Language Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Predicting student achievement in English language learning has traditionally relied on standardized tests and trainer opinions. While these methods provide precious insights, they often fail to capture nuanced components of language talent and character gaining knowledge of desires. Existing techniques commonly contain static checks that don't adapt to the evolving nature of scholar overall performance or provide personalized feedback. This study proposes a singular approach utilizing GPT-3 (Generative Pre-skilled Transformer) models to enhance the prediction of scholar fulfillment in English language learning. GPT-3 models, regarded for their superior natural language processing skills, provide a dynamic and personalized evaluation of scholar texts. Unlike traditional methods, GPT-three can compare complex language capabilities, including grammar, vocabulary utilization, and coherence, and generate tailored remarks that addresses precise areas of development. The methodology entails amassing a various dataset of scholar-written texts and engagement metrics. These data are preprocessed and used to high-quality-song a GPT-three version, allowing it to assess language talent and predict destiny performance. The satisfactory-tuned version analyzes student submissions, generates personalized feedback, and predicts fulfillment primarily based on found styles and contextual know-how. Results exhibit that the GPT-3 based approach substantially improves the accuracy of fulfillment predictions and offers greater actionable feedback as compared to conventional methods. The version’s potential to generate real-time, contextually relevant remarks complements the gaining knowledge of revel in by using addressing man or woman wishes and adapting to student progress.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs) for Automated Classification of E-Waste Components: Focusing on Circuit Boards, Batteries, and Cables
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The proliferation of electronic waste (e-waste) has become a pressing environmental concern, necessitating efficient methods for its classification and management. Though there are traditional methods which are used when sorting and recyling e-waste, they are time-consuming, costly and most of the time, are not accurate and hence, a lot of resources are wasted in the process. This research aims at extending the use of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs) in the classification of critical e-waste components namely circuit boards, batteries, and cables. The proposed method fully utilizes the capacity of extracting features of DCNNs in order to accurately detect and sort these components by means of the receiving visual information. For training and testing the DCNN model a dataset was created and preprocessed and the target images included circuit boards of different orientations and sizes, batteries and cables. The architecture of a network was created considering aspect of depth and computational complexity guarantying high accuracy and feasible time for great data set processing. In the evaluation process of the model, a comparison was made with various standard performance measures, with checklists such as accuracy, precision and recall and F1-score to rate the prowess of the proposed model in taking part in the classifying process of e-waste components. From the analysis, the proposed DCNN model reached classification accuracy over 95.9% on all the categories suggesting the model can be used as a tool to sort e-waste automatically. The paper also considers the issues of implementing such technology in the current recycling systems and the overall advantages, which will be the increase of the sorting efficiency, decreased labor expenses, as well as elevated recovery rates of materials demanded in the market.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Real-time Data Analytics of Automatic Industrial Robot for High Speed Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In Industry 4.0, industrial robot trajectory planning requires real-time collision avoidance. This is solved by our innovative Collision Criticality (CC) LSTM-DRL approach. This work suggests navigating many landscapes with diverse barriers using deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and long-short-term memory for data analytics in high Speed Communication. The robot's current state is used by Crit LSTM DRL to estimate collision timing and obstacle CC. Obstacle courses use CC ranks. Robotics creates a fixed-dimensional vector that accurately represents reality using LSTM models. After that, the robot's current state is added to this vector to complete its perception and cognition. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) optimalizes state values using input data. At each time step, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) identify the next state values for all possible actions. System operation depends on the highest value's action. We learned three environmental models in this research. A scenario with five, 10, or one to ten barriers was classified. These models were tested for adaptability to different obstacle densities. In obstacle-rich situations, researchers tested these three models' strengths and weaknesses. Testing the algorithm in various settings proves its efficacy. The program also considers the combined influence of impediments on the robot by portraying them as a joint state. CC-LSTM-DRL performs well in Industry 4.0's dynamic and challenging conditions, according to experiments. Mobile robots can confidently navigate changing environments due to their versatility and flexibility, making them ideal industrial tools.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Recommendations for Special Need Patients using Deep Learning and Blockchain Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper describes a new way to use blockchain security and deep learning to make better healthcare proposals for people with special needs. Using deep learning techniques, this method gives outstanding prediction accuracy, precision, memory, and an amazing Area Under the Curve (AUC). It is necessary for reliable clinical decision support. Blockchain technology's unchangeable record and secure systems protect data privacy and ensure data accuracy. This solves important problems in healthcare data management. Additionally, homomorphic encryption safeguards patient privacy by enabling secure computations on safeguarded data, resulting in robust analytical insights. Edge artificial intelligence systems make platforms more flexible and scalable for real-time healthcare applications, which helps computers work more efficiently. Even with these changes, issues like following rules and making the blockchain work on a larger scale persist. To enhance the use of these technologies in hospital settings, researchers should concentrate on improving legal structures and blockchain systems in the future.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models Using Adaptive Epoch Training for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a sound consequence of diabetes, leading to significant loss of vision worldwide. Early detection and classification are vital for effective management and treatment. This study evaluates the several deep learning model performances, including Sequential CNNs, InceptionV3, ResNet50, and VGG19, using an adaptive epoch training approach for the classification of DR severity. The training approach consists of an initial phase of 80 epochs followed by up to 20 additional epochs with early stopping to prevent overfitting. The proposed methodology addresses challenges such as inter-observer variability and the need for scalable solutions in healthcare. Our analysis reveals that pre-trained models show consistent performance improvements with extended training, while the custom CNN demonstrates significant gains. Experimental results depict the effectual output of our approach in achieving high accuracy and generalization, providing a promising tool which automates DR examination and testing.
