articleTitle: The Role of Hyperparameter Tuning and Feature Engineering in Enhancing Machine Learning Models for Crop Disease Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In this study, we provide a novel approach to teaching machine learning models to analyze farm illnesses. This strategy uses feature engineering and hyperparameter optimization. They are recursive feature elimination, random forest, and genetic algorithm optimization. Random Forest (RF, GAO, RFE). The recommended technique uses three algorithms to create it. Random Forest, an ensemble learning approach, combines decision tree forecasts to improve accuracy and usefulness. Each decision tree makes its own forecasts. Genetic algorithm optimization uses flexible hyperparameter adjustments to optimize the model. Natural selection served as the inspiration for this strategy. Iterative feature elimination improves the model. This procedure selects key issue aspects one by one. This work aims to enhance machine learning models for faster and better crop disease detection. These approaches will enable this.

articleTitle: Designing Resilient Network Architectures for Disaster Recovery
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Digital infrastructure is always changing, therefore secure network designs are essential to keep things running amid natural catastrophes. The Dynamic Resilience Framework (DRF) uses ARO, DDI, and ERA to strengthen networks. Many prominent methods are used to compare the proposed framework against new ones. Hierarchical network design, SDN, distributed cloud architecture, and active-active redundancy are examples. The experiment simulates disaster situations to examine each network architecture's downtime, data recovery, and resource use. DDI scores reveal how well components interact; ARO scores show how repetition varies with difficulty. ERA scores measure resource efficiency and how to scale them with demand. You may analyze qualitative and quantitative statistics, user comments, and qualitative assessments. DRF outperforms other methods in ARO, DDI, and ERA. Statistics show that these performance variances are considerable, proving that the proposed structure is strong and adaptive. This research provides a comprehensive catastrophic recovery strategy, adding to the resilient network architecture discussion. The results will help companies determine the best ways to protect their digital assets against unexpected challenges.

articleTitle: Designing Robust AI Systems for Autonomous Vehicles Against Adversarial Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: More people are purchasing autonomous vehicles (AVs), which raises concerns about how simple it would be for bad guys to attack them. AI-powered devices must be trustworthy to keep people and automobiles safe as they improve. This article suggests we need AI systems to discover and reduce self-driving vehicle threats immediately. You require real-time monitoring, outlier detection, and good training techniques for this position. Strong training approaches safeguard the AI model from unintended modifications with multiple datasets. Strange AV activity or patterns may be detected using anomaly detection, allowing you to take immediate safety measures. Advanced deep learning algorithms are crucial for real-time threat detection and reduction, according to the research. Because of its surveillance and analysis tools, the AI system can instantly adapt to changing events and eliminate potential hazards before they become safety risks. To ensure all antivirus businesses deliver top-notch protection, this article advocates for consistent standards and government monitoring. Risk analyses, system upgrades, and security all work to protect AV network data and communication connections. The recommended basic architecture strengthens self-driving vehicle AI systems to manage smart threats from other drivers and protect passengers and onlookers. This work is crucial to ensuring that antivirus products remain safe and trustworthy as digital threats and vulnerabilities develop.

articleTitle: A Mixed-Methods Investigation of Trait Emotional Intelligence and Emotional Expression in Language Classes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This mixed-methods investigation explores the relationship between trait emotional intelligence (TEI) and emotional expression in language classes, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of emotional dynamics within language learning environments. Quantitative data was collected through a survey-based approach, incorporating established scales like the Trait Emotional Intelligence Questionnaire (TEIQue) to assess TEI levels, alongside tailored questions to gauge emotional expression. Participant demographics were gathered to account for potential confounding variables, and structured classroom observations documented instances of emotional expression among students and teachers. Qualitative data was obtained through semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions, delving into themes such as the influence of emotional intelligence on language learning and strategies to promote emotional expression. Additionally, language class activities were designed to foster emotional expression and awareness among students, providing opportunities for reflection and engagement. Data analysis involved both quantitative techniques, including descriptive and inferential statistics, and qualitative approaches, such as thematic analysis. Integration of data through triangulation and mixed methods analysis facilitated a comprehensive understanding of how TEI influences emotional expression in language classes. The findings offer insights into the interplay between emotional intelligence and classroom dynamics, informing educational practices and interventions aimed at enhancing emotional and academic outcomes in language learning settings. Ethical considerations were prioritized throughout the research process to safeguard participants' rights and privacy

articleTitle: Exploring the Mantras and Machines of Modern Management Medleys
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Examining the complex relationship between traditional management theory and state-of-the-art tools, “Exploring the Mantras and Machines of Modern Management Medleys” dives into this topic. It suggests a novel approach to study by integrating sentiment analysis, Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), and regression analysis to provide an in-depth and evidence-based look at the topic at hand. Six other methodologies, including survey analysis, case study approach, literature review, observational research, interview analysis, and experimental analysis, are contrasted with this one. The suggested technique is shown to be superior based on evaluations of its efficacy and resource consumption. The suggested strategy was also shown to be more efficient and cost-effective in terms of resource consumption. These results validate the suggested technique as an efficient and re-source-friendly option for investigating contemporary management cocktail recipes. Incorporating sentiment analysis for assessing emotional tone, latent semantic analysis for identifying topics, and regression analysis for quantitative comprehension, this work exemplifies the value of interdisciplinary investigation.

articleTitle: Unlocking Industry Potential Through the Convergence of AI and Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: AI and blockchain technology might make many sectors safer, more open, and more efficient. It proposes an autonomous AI-based solution that leverages blockchain and machine learning to address industry issues including theft, data security, and inefficiency. The recommended response utilizes AI to track patterns and estimate what they are. Additionally, blockchain smart contracts ensure data exchanges remain secure and unchangeable. We tested the paradigm in banking, healthcare, and supply chain management. Transaction speed, data quality, fraud reduction, and operational efficiency were the main success factors. The findings showed 32% less theft, 45% better data accuracy and security, and 28% higher company efficiency. Process latency was 20% lower than in centralized systems. The findings suggest that AI with blockchain may simplify decision-making, data security, and operations. It may be an excellent choice for firms looking to profit from the digital shift.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Landscapes and the Laby-Rinths of Logic Underlying Layers of Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The deep learning landscape and the logic labyrinths beneath it are examined in Deep Learning Landscapes and the Logic Labyrinths Under-lying Layers of Learning. The proposed strategy considers theory, model, and moral reflection from a broad perspective. This strategy simplifies deep learning, resulting in smarter, more moral models. The academic element of our technique details how deep learning models learn and make judgments, exhibiting neural network mathematical foundations. Model refinement and training methods require academic understanding. We have employed several deep learning approaches in academic and practical activities. CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, transformers, and generative adversarial networks are examples. These solutions provide researchers and practitioners with hands-on expertise to improve model design and hyperparameters. We add ethics to our technique to address fairness, openness, and prejudice in deep learning systems. Our strategy promotes ethical AI development, resulting in fairer and more dependable models. The recommended strategy consistently outperforms the present one in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1. Ethical assessments reveal that the suggested technique is fairer, clearer, and less prejudiced than present methods. Due to its efficiency and morality, the proposed method is ideal for deep learning.

articleTitle: The Role of AI In Flexible and Collaborative Intelligent Manufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: AI is crucial to establishing smart industrial systems that operate together and can evolve, as this article shows. The beginning emphasizes the importance of artificial intelligence and contemporary production's flexibility and teamwork. Manufacturing can employ AI in various ways. AI can adapt to market changes, factory conditions, and product designs, making it versatile. Friendly robots (cobots) and autonomous systems maximize resource consumption and efficiency with human labor. AI-driven quality control systems discover even the slightest defects in a product using computer vision and deep learning. By anticipating repairs, predictive maintenance systems save downtime and extend gear life. A comparison of research shows the recommended technique outperforms others. However, adaptability emphasizes how scalable and flexible the recommended solution is to accommodate a variety of business objectives and conditions. Comparative teamwork studies reveal that the recommended strategy simplifies collaboration, improving worker safety, efficiency, and happiness.

articleTitle: Ephemeral Echoes and Their Resonating Impact in To-Day's Digital and Electronic Age
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: We need further research on "Ephemeral Echoes and Their Resonating Impact in Today's Digital and Electronic Age" to understand how digital information evolves and influences society. This research examines online transience using social media, emotion, and continual investigations. The technique provides a holistic view of how change impacts digital culture, human behavior, and society. This study's approach is superior to others since it's novel. The recommended approach is favored because it can handle various dimensions, evaluate data, be accurate, scalable, allow in-depth study, and function effectively. This novel technique uses modern data analytics technologies, natural language processing, and quantitative and qualitative research methodologies to analyze transitory data quicker and more precisely. The recommended method is superior to standard methods for determining digital and electronic content's duration. The results demonstrate how comprehensive the technique is, allowing a complete analysis of ephemerality. A thorough investigation using contemporary data analytics technologies might reveal transience's emotional and intimate aspects. It is scalable and produces accurate, exact answers for large quantities. This strategy illuminates all facets of ephemerality. It speeds up research, making it a perfect tool for researching digital occurrences in the computer era.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Optimized Cluster Head Selection in Heterogeneous WSNs for IoT Deployments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Despite the study proposing the LEACH methodology, its ineffectiveness has been shown. A non-deterministic polynomial (NP) is a difficult issue to optimise for CH. Using an Artificial Immune System (AIS) and Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO), this study suggests a new routing algorithm. This paper also discusses the best route choice, which may increase network lifetime and reduce energy consumption. We make good use of a lot of metaheuristics techniques, including PSO and AIS. Using principles from neuroscience and social science, the PSO algorithm tackles challenges in a wide range of fields, with a focus on computing and engineering. Particles are creatures that move around the multi-dimensional search distance, where every particle represents a possible solution to the multi-dimensional optimisation issue. The most recent development in AI, AIS takes its cues from the workings of the immune response in living organisms. Immune systems control both the inborn and adapted immunity response's defence mechanisms. Since the latter includes metaphors like variety, self-control, recognition, and memory growth, it is more significant. The AIS outperforms the Heterogeneous Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH-HPR) and particle swarm optimisation (PSO) in terms of results from experiments. Artificial Immune System (AIS) retains an extensive amount of active nodes while maintaining its efficiency with a 98.5% accuracy rate. AIS is more energy efficient, which means nodes last longer, but it's not much better than PSO and LEACH-HPR in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Personalized Medicine in the Age of Big Data and Advanced Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study explores customized medicine using the customized Treatment Optimization Framework (PTOF). Advanced analytics and big data transform customized healthcare. The Genetic Variant Prioritization Algorithm (GVPA), Dynamic Treatment Response Prediction Model (DTRP), and Optimal Treatment Adjustment Algorithm (OTAA) make personalized medicine more dynamic and adaptable. PTOF is compared against GenoOpti, PharmaSys, BioDecide, RxPro, MedAlign, and OmniCare in our study. The results reveal that PTOF excels at data combination, prediction, and ethics. PTOF's capacity to adjust treatment regimens based on real-time projections raises the bar for specialist medicine and enhances patient care.

articleTitle: Blending the Powers of BERT and Neural Style Transfer for Artistic Text Generation in Poetry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Developing original content that prioritizes both semantic elegance and truth requires the collaboration of two individuals. The visually distinctive appearance of this piece is achieved through the integration of BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) capabilities with the sophisticated aesthetics of Neural Style Transfer (NST). Three distinct methods are merged in the proposed method: decoding and generation (D&G), semantic encoding (BERT), and style embedding (NST). The initial methodology, "Semantic Encoding with BERT," guarantees that the resultant poem remains faithful to its initial intent through the utilization of contextual embeddings in BERT. Second, you may create a unique poetry by inserting style components into an existing reference text using Style Embedding with NST. The third algorithm deciphers the style embeddings using an RNN-based generative model. Poetry that is both original and contextualized is the result. Scientific evaluation and comparison of the proposed technique with more conventional approaches is based on a number of criteria. Among these considerations are creative variety, originality, continuity, diversity, meaning accuracy, cohesiveness, and style preservation. The results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional ones in generating aesthetically original and easily comprehensible prose.

articleTitle: Exploring the Integration of Wearable Sensors Technologies in Professional Sports for Enhanced Performance and Injury Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This report discusses how wearable monitor technologies might improve and prevent injury in professional sports. Method phases include cleaning sensor data, dimensionality reduction, grouping, and machine learning. Fourier changes, wavelet compression, and statistical feature extraction can clean, consistent, and make data usable. By combining and decreasing data dimensions, the strategy discovers relevant patterns that influence forecast models. Neural networks are more accurate and effective for assessing sports success and injury risk using machine learning. On data accuracy, latency, power efficiency, signal stability, and wearability, it compares favorably to other techniques. The proposed strategy is the best for real-time sports applications since it excels in all areas. The strategy enhances performance and makes smart tech secure and pleasant, making gamers more eager to use it. In the end, this research helps players make informed choices that increase their ability, prevent injury, and improve professional sports achievements.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Mysteries of Dark Matter and Dark Energy Through Advanced Computational Models and Simulations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: To understand dark matter and dark energy, astrophysicists have developed new computer approaches. We provide a unique technique that integrates N-body simulations, deep learning, and adaptive mesh refinement to study the universe's mysterious forces. Despite their unsurpassed accuracy, N-body simulations have struggled with computing speed and scalability restrictions when simulating dark matter particle gravitational interactions. However, the Barnes-Hut technique considerably improves these simulations' scalability and processing efficiency. Deep learning is our second pillar, developing cutting-edge machine learning. CNNs, RNNs, and other neural networks may anticipate complicated cosmic occurrences and duplicate them exactly. Our third invention, Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR), improves resource use by targeting computing resources. Scalability and resource efficiency are adaptive mesh refinement's strengths. Our comprehensive approach outperforms older approaches due to its mix of contemporary methodologies and N-Body Simulation accuracy. This distinctive method gives scholars a tremendous toolset to understand our planet's underlying cosmic processes. It fills holes in standard approaches and advances dark matter and dark energy research.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Intrusion Detection Model for Internet of Things Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The proposed IoT intrusion detection model uses machine learning to compensate for data loss in convolutional neural networks' initial pooling layer and the gradient vanishing problem that recurrent neural networks face when processing long sequential input. Time series data for intrusion detection models is optimized using Gramme matrix field visualization. To reduce data loss, the SoftPool pooling layer replaced the original. The recurrent neural network uses a bidirectional gated recurrent unit with fewer parameters and a multi-head structure modeled after the self-attention mechanism. Baseline data will be TON-IoT data. The number of heads multi-head bidirectional gated recurrent unit, pooling layer topologies, and visualization approaches are experimental parameters. The simulation results show that a three-head structure, SoftPool for layer pooling, and for accuracy, precision, detection rate, F1 score, and false positive rate, multi-class classification works well with field and Gramme matrix visualization. The suggested model outperforms state-of-the-art models in accuracy, detection rate, F1 score, and false positive rate by 0.14, 0.09, 0.13, and 0.08. Modern machine learning improves IoT intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Antenna Designs for Enhanced WSN Signal Propagation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Using cutting-edge antenna design and signal processing, this study shows a new way to improve the spread of signals in Wireless Sensor Networks. Meta surface technology, adaptive beamforming, and cognitive radio are all parts of the WSN signal transmission optimization method. Cognitive spectrum sharing, metasurface-based beam steering, and adaptable beamforming are some of the most important ways. These mathematical models and formulas help the network figure out the direction of signals, find the best frequencies, and change the characteristics of antennas. In the part called "Findings," the suggested antenna design approach is put up against six other methods. Performance tests like SNR, disturbance reduction, and resource use show that the suggested method works better. It does a great job of SNR, reducing interference, and being flexible so that transmission can be reliable in tough WSN settings. The method's usefulness and effectiveness are shown by better use of resources. This study shows that plans for WSN antennas have a lot of potential. WSNs that are robust can talk to each other in changing environments thanks to adaptive beamforming, meta surface technology, and cognitive spectrum sharing.

articleTitle: Third Eye
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study report therefore establishes and applies an assistive aid commonly known as the "Third Eye" in assisting the vision impaired persons in their mobility. The system is built with an ESP32- CAM board and Arduino Nano board at its core to combine the advantages of both systems to offer a compact and affordable solution.The Traditional ESP32-CAM which serves as the vision sensor acquisition agent captures the real time images and videos. On the users’ side, haptic feedback is provided with the help of the Arduino Nano, as well as data interpreting. The main goal of the project is to grant the visually impaired clients a better chance of mobility and security by providing an efficient and low-cost solution for obstacle detection.Some of the sections that are captured include; pre conception of Third Eye, design, development & testing. It digs into the integration process, the problems faced in development, the low-down of the physical aspect or the hardware, and the control aspect or the software. An analysis of performance proves that the system works well in various cases, indicating the possibility of using the system as an assistance to the blind and persons with low vision.This practice-based investigation reveals how IoT technologies especially the ESP32-CAM and Arduino Nano can be creatively applied to actual issues of assistive technology. The current global economy has given new opportunities for the new creation and intensification of these systems.

articleTitle: Enhanced Diabetes Prediction Using Optimization and Clustering Techniques with Secure Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: One of the chronic diseases is diabetes that is rapidly increasing globally, impacting 422 million people. Because diabetes has a protracted asymptomatic period, detecting the disease early is essential to producing clinically meaningful outcomes. Around half of all diabetics go undetected because of this asymptomatic phase. Correct identification of typical and less typical indications seen at different phases of the illness is essential for effective detection. Generally speaking, diabetes is characterised by high blood sugar and perhaps insufficient insulin synthesis. The proportion of diabetic patients worldwide has dramatically increased recently. Reducing the overall number of diabetes cases requires taking this issue seriously. Numerous research groups have investigated various data mining systems for analysing health data, including patient datasets with diabetes. Using parametric analysis, data mining (DM) can synthesise useful knowledge from health data. In order to assess medical data pertaining to diabetes diagnosis, this study presents the Iterative Cuckoo Search Optimisation clustering algorithm, which is based on adaptive gradient density. The Deep VGG Net classifier is also utilised to distinguish between data that has diabetes and data that does not. The prime contribution of the research is the use for Refined ELGamal security algorithms to ensure cloud security while mining patient disease results.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Robustness of Compact Neural Networks in Noisy Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Compact neural networks are becoming increasingly popular because they operate effectively and need less computer power. They still struggle in loud situations. We suggest and evaluate three novel techniques to make compact neural networks more noise-resistant: noise-aware training, adversarial relationship-based training and testing, and noise filtering and knowledge distillation. Networks were subjected to controlled noise during noise-aware training to simulate noisy environments. Data shows that this methodology enhances accuracy, precision, and F1 scores significantly above typical training approaches. Adversarial Training and Evaluation employs adversarial instances. That makes the network more resistant to attacks from other networks. This method may make adversarial-vulnerable systems safer and more robust. Noise filtering and information distillation combine data preparation with information from larger, more reliable models. The two-step approach enhances accuracy while maintaining competitiveness and F1 scores. Our comparative study examines the benefits and downsides of each method to help you pick the best one for your application. Small neural networks are more robust using the provided strategies. Their data-driven responses to noise, bad actor assaults, and data faults make tiny neural networks more trustworthy in hectic real-world circumstances. The improvement of AI security and performance is facilitated by the usage of alternate data formats.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Threshold Routing Protocol for Enhancing Energy Efficiency in Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: WSN deployment and operation require overcoming various obstacles. Data security, endurance of batteries, and connectivity are these concerns. Since sensor nodes are commonly put in distant and inaccessible regions, constant replacement of batteries or recharging is impracticable. Transmission range limits coverage and the network's capacity to gather data from far nodes. Wireless communications might be eavesdropped; hence data security is essential to secure critical network data. To address these issues, the thesis designs WSN protocols that maximize energy savings, coverage, connection, and intruder protection. In this study, distance and energy are key characteristics for energy-efficient routing strategies in diverse networks. A node's remaining power and distance proportions to the overall energy consumption at the level in question and the total amount of each node's separation from the starting station constitute these metrics. Energy-Efficient Transport Protocol Utilizing Threshold Hierarchy (EEPH) yields better results than TSEP. The Hybrid Grey Wolf Optimizing Method (HGWOM) framework we created leverages probability-based cluster leader selection. Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) optimizes the structure. A GWOLEACH hybrid finds the fittest junction based on remaining energy and the nearest base station distance. Experiments comparing HGWOM to LEACH and TSEP showed improved network reliability and high packets delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Decoding the Mystery of Statistical Sequences and Speculative Data Spaces
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A special method called "Statistical Sequence Decomposition and Speculative Space Analysis" (SSDSSA) is used to look into both real and made-up data spaces in this study. Compared to other ways of looking at large amounts of data, SSDSSA works better because it is faster, easier to understand, and covers more ground. SSDSSA can break sequences by using t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) to reduce the number of dimensions and Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) to connect them to made-up data. This reveals data patterns, trends, and linkages that would otherwise be difficult to interpret. SSDSSA out-performs other methods on ranks one to five. SSDSSA outperforms most approaches in complexity, flexibility, speed, readability, and versatility. This paper suggests techniques to improve data analysis in biology, economics, and other domains.

articleTitle: Semantic Graph Convolution Networks based Deep Learning Model for Spam Review Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Consumers heavily depend on users' evaluations of service-oriented websites. Numerous evaluations on review platforms, nonetheless, fail to accurately represent the genuine attributes of products due to business motivations. Consequently, monitoring website operations and maintaining a clean network environment requires the identification and management of fraudulent reviews. A semantic graph convolution network integrated with semantic similarity is introduced to improve the detection of erroneous research through text classification utilizing a graph neural network based on words and documents. Employ the TF-IDF feature value, the correlation between words and comments as determined by the PMI (Pointwise Mutual Information) index, and semantic similarity assessed by word embedding metrics. Upon the creation of the vocabulary-comment heterogeneous text network, the high-order feature information between word and comment nodes can be recorded and consolidated for classification purposes. The suggested strategy enhances accuracy by 7%, 4.8%, and 1.3% relative to CNN, LSTM, and Text-GCN on the public dataset.

articleTitle: IoT Based Irrigation Management System For Smart Farming Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Agriculture is one of the main resources of the profession in India and plays an important role in contributing GDP to 4%. Effective addressing of food loss and waste is important in securing food and nutrition, meeting climate goals and reducing environmental strain. The adoption of smart farming serves as an effective practice to guarantee food production and safeguard the environment. It is important to develop and implement smart farming technologies to meet food demands and improve the livelihoods of farmers sustainably. In agriculture, using Internet of Things (IoT) technology has made farming more efficient and sustainable. Smart farming, which relies on IoT, is a big change from old-fashioned farming methods to using data for precision farming. This change is made possible by putting sensors, data analysis tools, and actuators on farms. These tools help farmers monitor their farms in real-time, analyse data, and make better decisions. By using IoT, farmers can use resources better, reduce risks, and produce more food, which is important for feeding the world while dealing with environmental challenges. IoT-based smart farming brings many benefits to farming. For example, using sensors to measure soil moisture, temperature, and nutrients gives farmers great insights into their crops and the environment. Automated irrigation systems, guided by data, can water the crops precisely, reducing waste and improving yields. Similarly, IoT tools can help farmers track their animals’ health, behaviour, and productivity in real-time, making it easier to manage farms and increase efficiency. In this paper, an attempt is made to envisage farm monitoring system and the water scarcity issue to deal with the optimised use of scarce resources such as water for irrigation by allowing the system to take the decision on its own with minimal human interventions.

articleTitle: Transportation Path Planning Model for Multi-Constraint Unmanned Aerial Vehicle in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In response to the path planning problem of using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) for blood transportation, with the objective of minimizing the total distance travelled by the UAV, a multi-constraint drone blood transportation path planning model is established. Taking into account the limited number of drone take-off and landing platforms and the safety time intervals for continuous drone take-off and landing, a drone take-off scheduling strategy is designed to reduce the total time spent by UAV completing transportation tasks. Additionally, an Imperial Competition Algorithm based on Imperialist Competitive Algorithm is proposed to solve this problem. This algorithm introduces a sine disturbance strategy and adds Imperial Reform stages to improve the search accuracy of the algorithm. It utilizes acceptance criteria related to solution quality to maintain the diversity of the population. Validation is conducted using benchmark examples and instances of drone blood transportation. The results indicate that the proposed algorithm can provide transportation solutions for drone blood transportation tasks that meet various constraints without any conflicts in drone take-off and landing. The drone take-off scheduling strategy effectively reduces the total time spent by UAV in completing tasks.

articleTitle: Leadership and Managerial Challenges in Driving Digital Transformation Using Robotics and AI in Finance and Accounting Function
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The advancement of AI and Robotics has become more apparent and feasible within the finance and accounting domains creating new pathways for improving business results. Nevertheless, the shift towards such technologies is not easy, especially in overseeing leadership and management. This paper explores the leadership and managerial challenges of organizations in digital transformation. The aim is to define principal challenges which include the resistance to change, lack of adequate skill within the workforce, and absence of clear vision from the leadership and find ways of addressing these challenges. This study’s uniqueness is in examining leadership aspects, which are hidden behind technology parameters of AI adoption and robotics. A qualitative research method is adopted, combining interviews which are semi-structured with 20-30 participants from the banking industry, financial institutions and corporate accounting. The proposed framework also underlines course of action in areas of training, leadership support, employee participation and feedback systems for CDSS technology implementation. The survey also shows that willingness to reject change is the biggest problem mentioned by 60% of the respondents, and the second most frequent challenge is labor force skills deficit rated by 50% of the respondents. Besides, the research also provides insights into the benefits received from AI and robotics implementation; more efficiency (67%) and better accuracy (60%)). Researchers should focus on analyzing consequences of these actions at a longer term and the ethical issues of using AI in finance.

articleTitle: Innovative Financial Services Driven by AI and Blockchain Synergy for Decentralized Trust and Personalized Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Since AI and blockchain technology combined, the financial services business has grown rapidly. This research examines how merging these two revolutionary technologies might provide unique banking systems with autonomous trust, improved security, and tailored services. Decentralized and open blockchain technology lets AI analyze massive data and provide reliable findings. It safeguards the accuracy of data and fosters trust among stakeholders. Blockchain technology also boosts AI. Financial institutions may provide safer, better-fitting products by combining blockchain's immutable record with AI's predictive analytics. Decentralized finance (DeFi), fraud detection systems, and smart contracts for automated financial transactions fall within this category. This research examines customized banking, AI-based financial advising, and blockchain-enabled overseas transactions. It also examines how autonomous trust procedures reduce middlemen, lowering costs and increasing transparency. This project will examine fintech and open finance platforms to demonstrate how AI and blockchain technologies might transform money management. Case studies will be used to present the possibilities. People would have better access to financial services, but protection and trust would remain high. The findings show that blockchain and AI will be crucial to creating innovative and open financial solutions.

articleTitle: An Effective Design of Intrusion Detection System With Classification Algorithms And Feature Reduction In Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: To safeguard networks from outside attacks, the Intrusion Detection System (IDS) has become an essential tool in the modern realm. With the proliferation of data-generating and -sharing tools like Big Data, CC, and the IoT, it has become more challenging to isolate characteristics that contribute to effective intrusion detection systems (IDS). This problem has been addressed by using feature selection techniques (FSA) to filter out superfluous characteristics and isolate critical ones from network data. This has resulted in the creation of intrusion detection system models that are suitable for large-scale networks and have reduced costs while producing greater performance. A number of FSA classifiers have been investigated and tested in an effort to identify the best one for intrusion detection system capture. On real-time datasets, the top-performing classifier utilizing an appropriate feature reduction approach (FST) has been tested. Separately, we compared the efficacy and performance of FSA classifiers to those that included all characteristics. The proposed model (DT + RFE) is said to enhance IDS performance on the NSL-KDD, CICDDoS2019, and CICIDS2017 datasets, achieving 99.21%, 99.97%, and 99.94% average accuracy, respectively, while decreasing computation cost.

articleTitle: Smart Irrigation System to Minimize Water Usage in Agriculture Using Fully Connected Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The pillar for effective farming is water management in irrigation, especially where growing water scarcity challenges are receiving much attention. This paper introduces a smart irrigation system whose water use remains optimized through the FCNN model when soil moisture conditions become critical. The data used in the experiments included temperature, pressure, and altitude readings that match the soil moisture levels, hence reporting remarkable improvements in accuracy and other aspects of performance. The accuracy of the FCNN model is 95% because it correctly classifies test cases into the validation set. The SVM model yielded an accuracy of 92%, showing its weakness in extracting the nonlinear relation in the data. Moreover, the precision and recall concerning some classes were fairly weak in the SVM model. With this work, the possibility of neural networks in revealing inherent nonlinear relationships characteristic of the data involved in agriculture applications thus justifies the superior performance of the FCNN approach toward the design of precision irrigation systems. This paper thus finally highlights the promise of scalable solutions to boost efficiency in water usage in agriculture as much as possible for sustainable agricultural practice.

articleTitle: Binary and Multiclass Leukemia Classification Using a Hybrid Deep Learning-ML Approach: Towards an Explainable AI Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Within the latter phases of the disease, the spreading of leukaemia in people generates a great deal of concern. Blood production in the bone marrow is hindered as a result of this. For the purpose of diagnosis in this instance, morphology analysis of blood cells from people is a method that is well-known and has been well tested. Both normal cells and cells that have been infected with leukaemia may be differentiated using the binary categorization. In addition, the therapy for various types of leukaemia is distinct from one another. For a correct diagnosis of the kind of leukaemia, it is also necessary to identify these subclasses. The determination of the leukaemia subtype requires the use of multiple classifications. Microscopical inspection of these blood cells is often used to accomplish this task. A further reason why the procedure for making choices is so important is that it necessitates the presence of a skilled pathology. This led to the creation of a software-based structure for diagnosis. The investigators used methods of machine learning that are considered to be state-of-the-art. These methods include support vector machine (SVM), random forest (RF), naïve bays, k-nearest neighbour (KNN), and others. However, these methods result in the accuracy of classification that is restricted. Researchers also make use of more sophisticated varieties of deep learning techniques. The suggested XGBoost approach outperformed all models with 97% accuracy. DenseNet-XGBoost and Xception-RF performed well, but Inception-ResNet and Random Forest(RF) performed moderately. ResNet-RF was lowest. Thus, the suggested leukemia categorization method works best.

articleTitle: Steganography Authenticated Quadrant Stacked Multiple Image Visual Cryptography Scheme with Perfect Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Visual Cryptography Scheme (VCS) is an image based encryption procedure which encodes the secret image into multiple binary images called shares. The shares are random meaningless patterns of identical number of 0’s and 1’s, and hence the shares do not expose the secret. In conventional VCS, shares are printed over transparencies or transmitted digitally to the receiver. During decryption, shares are overlaid to recover the secret which can be recognizable by Human Visual System (HVS) devoid of any processing. However the deciphered secret image will not be a perfect reconstruction in conventional VCS and it encounters contrast loss. "Two-in-One Image Secret Sharing Scheme" (TiOISSS) combines VCS that can decipher the ambiguous secret recognizable through HVS during the first phase and “Polynomial Image Secret Sharing Scheme” (PISSS) to achieve perfect reconstruction in the second phase. TiOISSS is implemented for single secret in most works. In the proposed scheme, TiOISSS is extended to share multiple secrets, in terms of four secrets per share, by stacking the shares over the four quadrants, termed as "Two-in-One Multiple Image Secret Sharing Scheme (TiOMISSS)". The number of secrets can be extrapolated as one share for every four secrets. Steganography data is encoded into the shares for authentication. The efficiency of the scheme is assessed using metrics PSNR and SSIM. The scheme results in better quality with infinite PSNR and SSIM value of 1 due to perfect reconstruction.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Analytics and Decision-Making in Modern Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This study introduces a novel technique to analyze data and make real-time judgments in sensor networks. This system handles several sensor data issues using innovative machine learning, secure computing, flexible filtering, anomaly detection, and blockchain technology. We evaluated the framework's efficacy by comparing it comprehensively with existing methodologies and finding that it enhanced performance across several performance indicators. The approach is accurate, quick, resource-efficient, error-tolerant, and data-safe. Complex machine learning algorithms improve data analytics accuracy and prediction. This enables rapid, precise judgments in shifting scenarios. For data-sensitive applications that must fulfill tight regulatory criteria, the technique uses safe multi-party computer technology to safeguard and secure data. Due to noise reduction and signal clarity, adaptive filtering improves data quality. However, anomaly detection systems find and resolve unusual data patterns, making them more dependable. Blockchain-based data security ensures unambiguous, unchangeable records. This prevents unauthorized data access and changes. For critical applications to perform properly, sensor data must be accurate and trustworthy. An ablation study details how each item fits within the framework and how vital it is to improve the total system. The recommended technique, with its holistic approach, represents a significant technological breakthrough in sensor networks, enabling healthcare monitoring, environmental sensing, and manufacturing automation.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enhanced AI Security and Trust Through Auditable Decision-Making and Data Integrity in Modern Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: AI and blockchain can make companies safer and more trustworthy. AI can handle massive quantities of data and make complicated judgments, but its lack of clarity and reliance on centralized data present safety, accountability, and openness concerns. Blockchain ensures data is accurate, clear, and simple to track with its decentralized and unchangeable record. Blockchain can improve AI systems by making decision-making more open and safer for AI data. Blockchain protects AI model data from unauthorized changes. This prevents illicit alterations and improves AI accuracy. Blockchain's autonomy lets parties independently verify AI decision-making, which fosters confidence. This study examines blockchain's primary AI protections. These include open data storage, validated AI models, and trustworthy smart contracts that make decisions automatically. Real-world examples from healthcare, finance, and supply chain management show how blockchain-enhanced AI could address data breaches, algorithmic bias, and machine accountability. These findings demonstrate that adding blockchain to AI systems increases their trustworthiness and makes AI use in modern organizations safer and more open.

articleTitle: Real-Time On-demand Topological Verification Tool for Circuit Debugging in Remote Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: High-speed internet communication envisages new possibilities which may alter the ways of the world. Virtualizing the pedagogy of education through Virtual classrooms is now well accepted. Remote Triggered Laboratories (RTL) are being explored as on-demand ‘Lab as a Service’. Laboratory education, which includes learning through scientific experiments and virtual intelligent tools, is crucial for students to comprehend and mastering experimental aspects of their theoretical studies. However, most virtual and remote labs lack runtime guidance tools akin to a physical teacher to assist students e.g. in wiring electronic circuits on a breadboard GUI. This offers a rich platform for the introduction of AI tools to complement human supervision. This paper reports our efforts in developing a novel ‘topological verification tool' (TVT) designed to identify wiring errors and provide real-time suggestions for correction. The intelligent TVT compares a student's designed circuit on a GUI breadboard with a stored wiring diagram displayed in electronic textbooks. It achieves this by comparing the incidence matrix extracted from the student's wired circuit with that of the stored circuit topology from textbooks. Upon comparison, the TVT highlights wiring errors or missing components and offers suggestions for necessary adjustments in the breadboard wiring. This paper details our experience in developing and integrating the TVT into our successfully deployed Remote Lab for electronics, ‘eVALIDATE,’ providing students with the experience of a virtual teacher aiding in runtime error correction. By enhancing the practical learning experience, the TVT ensures that students receive necessary ‘on-demand’ support to effectively master electronic circuit design, achieving the ‘supervised’ learning pedagogy even in a remote or virtual lab setting.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based IoT Device Authentication and Cost-Effective Key Management Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: IoT is seen as an exciting innovation that might start an entirely novel industrial revolution. A collection of Internet-connected devices. An unavoidable and pervasive framework is still an open problem in IoT research for embedded devices, neural networks, machine learning, and other widespread and universal systems. IoT systems rely on sensors and controllers. IoT uses millions of sensors to gather and share outside information with the public internet. Many applications analyze and evaluate diverse data collected from devices. Those compact devices for sensors have limited processing power. Security is crucial for precise data flow between verified users, which becomes more complicated in a network of IoT devices. IoT's decentralized architecture design faces security concerns include privacy, reliability, security, anonymity, and device-user trust. Due to limited resources in sensor devices, typical cryptographic techniques for identification and organizational management of keys are not suitable for IoT systems. Effective protection against electronic card theft, session data publication, external attack, passwords guessing, user sensing simulation, and anonymity for users is provided by the suggested technique. Because it meets all security criteria, the updated protocol offers better security. The simplest protocol that can survive all known attacks and provide the essential security is the suggested one. With a 99% success rate and superior performance across all measures, the findings show that the suggested blockchain technology IoT identification framework is the way to go.

articleTitle: Architecting the future of Mobile Edge Computing for Web 3.0 services over 5G/6G networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Planning Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) for The debut of Web 3.0 services across 5G and 6G networks changed IT and telecommunications. This report discusses the key concerns and trends in this emerging field. For Web 3.0 services like enhanced AI, IoT, VR, and compelling experiences, computer infrastructure must evolve. MEC brings computers and data closer to users to deliver responsive, fast, and reliable services. The backbone, 5G and 6G networks, provide unmatched speeds and functionality. Predictions are difficult. Beginning with affordability, flexibility, and resource efficiency, MEC system planning and design must balance these factors. With Web 3.0 services improving and becoming more popular, the design must enable many functions and purposes. You need cloud-native, edge computing, containerization, and microservices for quick expansion and resource optimization. In MEC, privacy and safety are major considerations. Always protect and update edge data. Future designs must feature end-to-end encryption, identity, and leak detection to protect user data and prevent theft. Also consider collaboration. Web 3.0 designs must be open and consistent since there are various devices, platforms, and communication methods. A standard architecture that allows devices and edge nodes communicate and exchange data is crucial. Utilizing bitcoin may make MEC organizations safer and more transparent. Another concern is resource management. For system performance and lifespan, load balancing, fault tolerance, and energy savings are crucial. AI-powered systems may assist optimize resource consumption, forecast assignment, and manage tasks. The future MEC architecture must include network slicing for 5G and 6G networks to virtualize network parts to meet service demands.

articleTitle: Self-Replicating Imperative Node Evaluator for Improved Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Cyber-attacks occur when someone attempts to gain unauthorized access to another person's or company's computer network. Network resources are considered compromised when several activities are made that potentially jeopardize their availability, anonymity, or reliability. Any time a system that detects intrusions notices questionable activity on an organization or system, for example, a potential breach of security policy, it notifies a management station. It is hard to efficiently identify threats in real-time due to the massive amount of data sent via cyber networks. The focus of this study is on developing an AI network for the purpose of detecting cyber threats. Checking user behavior for anomalies is an excellent way to spot fraud. When it comes to cyber defense, one of the biggest mysteries is how systems can detect previously unseen vulnerabilities and take action to mitigate or eradicate them. In order to stop cyber assaults, new cyber security measures are needed to identify malicious nodes before they interact. This study introduces an auto-triggering mode architecture and a replicating itself code for an aggressive node evaluator. As soon as it detects an intrusion, it may fix the network immediately, securing it and reducing the number of false alerts. The proposed model has a 98% success rate in both intruder identification and self-replication. Though progress has been made, there is still room for enhancement in reducing the number of false alarms.

articleTitle: Harnessing Quantum Entanglement for Enhancing the Integrity of Quantum Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In the realm of Quantum Cryptography, it is unlikely for an eavesdropper to intervene in the communication process; however, detecting intervention is not always feasible. Quantum Cryptography encompasses spooky phenomena from the realm of Quantum Physics. Quantum Entanglement – one of these phenomena – enables Quantum Communication by providing 100% detection of eavesdroppers whenever there is any unethical intervention. The rules of Quantum Entanglement preserve the integrity of Quantum Communication by ensuring the intactness between entangled particles irrespective of the distance between them. In quantum cryptography, photons are sent through polarized filters to generate a certain sequence of polarizations on either side (sender and receiver), which is compared after the communication takes place over a classical channel, such as a telephone. With conventional Quantum Cryptography, intervention can be prevented; however, it may not be detected every time. By using Quantum Entanglement, one can generate pairs of entangled photons on either side and transmit these pairs via a Quantum Channel (Fiber Optical Cable). Every time a particle is measured on any side of the communication, it immediately collapses the wave function of the other entangled pair of particles, resulting in the detection of intervention. Suppose there is any intervention other than the sender and receiver; in that case, Quantum Entanglement will provide detection of intervention at both sides as soon as an eavesdropper comes in between the communication, allowing the sender and receiver to be aware of the presence of the eavesdropper. The moment after the communication takes place, the sender and receiver can acknowledge the presence of an eavesdropper by identifying the correlation between the filters used in the communication to transmit the photons. This paper provides an approach to enhance the integrity of Quantum Cryptography by implementing certain spooky phenomena from the realm of Quantum Physics, like Quantum Entanglement, thus providing an extra layer of intervention detection and making Quantum Communication 100% secure.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning CNN with Optimization for Improved ECG Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: IOT has greatly enhanced healthcare by linking smart devices and facilitating more efficient communication. This study aims to classify ECG signals using a hybrid optimised deep learning technique that makes use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to help in the diagnosing of arrhythmias at early stage. Current deep learning algorithms often only handle singular or deterministic fluctuations of medical factors; this study aims to rectify that. To improve classification accuracy and system performance, the suggested method instead uses a hybrid of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Radial Basis Functions (RFDs) and Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO). The study found that dependable IoT networking is crucial for data aggregation. We show a new hybrid route selection algorithm called REL-RFD-PSO. Its goal is to make data transmission more efficient, reduce packet loss and latency, and replace more traditional methods like Dynamic Source Routing (DSR) and Routing Protocol based on Link Quality (REL) and Energy. The initiative's overarching objective is to enhance healthcare results and system dependability via the development of IoT-based Healthcare Monitoring Systems (HMS). These systems will provide non-invasive, continuous monitoring as well as fast alarms for early arrhythmia diagnosis. The CNN-RFD-PSO hybrid model has the maximum accuracy of 95.15%, 3.23% higher than the CNN model. Integrating RFD and PSO with CNN improves accuracy over other methods. The hybrid CNN-RFD-PSO model has the highest sensitivity, specificity, and F1-Score across all classes, improving by up to 3.43%, 2.1%, and 3.21% above CNN-PSO and CNN-RFD.

articleTitle: Leveraging Reinforcement Learning and Blockchain Technology for Enhanced Supply Chain Management Efficiency and Transparency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In today’s complex global economy, supply chain management (SCM) efficiency, transparency and security face enormous challenges. The benefits of emerging technologies such as reinforcement learning (RL) and blockchain provide a transformational approach to these issues. This study explores the integration of RL and blockchain technologies to enhance the SCM process. Reinforcement learning, a subset of machine learning, enables systems to learn optimal design through trial and error interactions with dynamic environments When applied to SCM, RL algorithms can continuously learn from supply chain data and adjust processes in real-time for routing, optimal inventory management, and demand forecasting. Blockchain technology supports RL by creating a decentralized and immutable ledger that provides transparency and security throughout the supply chain. Every transaction from raw materials to end products is recorded in the blockchain, creating an accountable process that increases trust among stakeholders, decreases it fraud and integrates smart contracts to keep the transaction automated, ensure compliance with predetermined conditions and increase operational efficiency. This paper presents a framework for integrating RL and blockchain in SCM, focusing on the benefits of integrating enterprises with these technologies. The proposed approach demonstrates how RL can enable adaptive intelligent decision making, while ensuring the integrity and transparency of blockchain data.

articleTitle: Utilizing Autoencoders to Reveal Hidden Insights for Effective Prediction of Employee Turnover in Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Employee turnover remains a important assignment for organizations, impacting productivity, morale, and operational continuity. Traditional strategies for predicting turnover regularly depend on demographic and task-related variables, yet fail to seize nuanced insights from unstructured statistics sources together with worker sentiment and engagement. This takes a look at proposes a singular technique utilizing autoencoders, a type of artificial neural network capable of mastering efficient representations of enter statistics, to uncover hidden styles inside various datasets associated with worker turnover. By leveraging anonymized textual statistics from employee surveys, overall performance reviews, and social media sentiments, the autoencoder model extracts latent features that reflect underlying elements contributing to turnover. The encoded representations are then utilized as inputs to predictive models, enhancing the accuracy and interpretability of turnover predictions. Through a comprehensive empirical analysis, the use of actual-global organizational information, we show the effectiveness of our technique in outperforming traditional methods, reaching better prediction accuracy and supplying actionable insights for HR practitioners. Furthermore, interpretability strategies inclusive of feature importance evaluation and visualization of latent spaces permit stakeholders to understand the driving forces behind turnover, facilitating proactive interventions and strategic choice-making. This research contributes to the sphere through bridging the space among superior machine gaining knowledge of strategies and human useful resource management, offering a robust framework for groups to preemptively cope with turnover challenges and foster a extra stable and engaged staff.

articleTitle: Designing an Explainable AI Framework for Leukemia Diagnosis: Integrating Customized CNN-SVM Models with Optimized Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: White blood cell appearance is one of the most important criteria for diagnosis for leukaemia. Since the conclusion of a diagnosis may be affected by the personal perspective of the person making the diagnosis, it is very advantageous to use a computerised methodology. To make this procedure easier, a doctor will look at blood smear slides under an electron microscope and make a diagnosis based on what they see. In terms of the deep learning frameworks, we are able to get measures like prospective accuracies. To get the most out of these frameworks, you need a big dataset with plenty of pictures. Due of its rarity, leukaemia databases often include photos of a smaller size. The suggested approach makes use of a tailored CNN integrated with a support vector machine. The classifier decides whether the cells are normal or infected. To verify the accuracy of this judgement, the widely used XAI framework LIME is used for interpretation. The present study makes use of the widely used and freely accessible ALL-IDB dataset. The suggested technique follows the beginning and follows by a presentation of relevant work. The findings, discussions, and conclusions are all included in the following section. It goes on to say that with a 96% accuracy rate, the suggested CNN-SVM method is much superior than GradCAM, Shaply, and LIME. The CNN-SVM model outperformed the others in terms of accuracy, whereas GradCAM outperformed them across the board. The explanations provided by Shaply and LIME were also rather accurate.

articleTitle: Analysis of Logistic Regression and CNN Using Parallel Computing for Chest X-ray Pneumonia Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Pneumonia, a severe respiratory infection, remains a leading global cause of death, particularly among vulnerable populations such as children and the elderly, underscoring the importance of early and accurate diagnosis. This study evaluates the performance of Logistic Regression (LR) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for classifying pneumonia using chest X-ray images. It also investigates the role of parallel processing techniques such as OpenMP for CPU parallelism and CUDA for GPU parallelism in accelerating model training and inference. Logistic Regression, known for its computational simplicity, achieves moderate performance gains with OpenMP. In contrast, CNNs, which are more suited for image-based tasks, demand higher computational resources but benefit significantly from CUDA, with substantial reductions in training time. Using a publicly available chest X-ray dataset, the models are assessed based on classification accuracy, training time, and computational efficiency, both with and without parallelization. The results indicate that CNNs outperform Logistic Regression in accuracy, while CUDA-enabled parallelism greatly enhances CNN training efficiency, highlighting the balance between computational demands and diagnostic performance in medical image classification.

articleTitle: Morphological Segmentation with Modified Otsu’s Method and Multi-Scale Morphological Processing for Shape Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Motological segmentation is essential in the domains of medical imaging, object recognition, and remote sensing. Classical approaches, such as Otsu's thresholding, fail miserably in the presence of noise, light, and complex backgrounds. These concerns are addressed by creating Modified Otsu's Method (MOM). Slow and precise segmentation, adaptive thresholding, and morphological processes are two new areas that MOM aims to tackle. The proposed MOM makes both local and global adjustments taking into account the image and text in order to mitigate the impact of variations in light intensity and noise level. Accurate segmentation and less noise artefacts are achieved by the use of dilation and erosion. On datasets including medical, nature, and remote sensing images, the suggested MOM algorithm achieves better results than previous top-tier segmentation approaches as well as Otsu's approach to generic thresholding based on experimental quantities. This study investigates the optimal execution time of the method for image processing in real time in terms of computing cost. Automated safety devices and medical imaging analysis are two examples of applications where MOM stands out for its exceptional performance in picture segmentation. Therefore, in order to make MOM more versatile and effective in a wide range of imaging contexts, future studies will use machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Predicting Adverse Thermal Events in Smart Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This research focuses on the prediction of adverse thermal events in smart buildings by leveraging machine learning techniques and advanced statistical modeling. The study utilizes the Adverse Condition and Critical Event Prediction Toolbox (ACCEPT) framework developed by NASA, which is based on the Multivariate State Estimation Technique (MSET). The process includes training a model on normal operating data, monitoring new data to estimate expected values, and detecting faults using the Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT). The implementation demonstrates the ability to accurately predict anomalies in thermal events, thus enhancing the operational efficiency and safety of smart building environments.

articleTitle: Designing The Energy Efficient And Memory-Conserving Cryptographic Algorithm For Iot Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In secure, resource-constrained environments there are new challenges viewed due to the impact of Internet of Things (IoT) on data-oriented applications. Owing to physical constraints such as capacity, capacity and calculating capability, classical cryptography algorithms are often worthless. To resolve the IoT applications’ security issues, resource constraints, and low energy capabilities, this research proposes a novel, extremely lightweight block cipher. The technique enhances security whilst minimising computational requirements when generating the keys. As a result of repeated encoding with the varying degrees of keys, this it is versatile to a number of IoT applications. Lower round and operation demand for granting and revoking the encrypted messages make the algorithm more energy-friendly, it is ideal for application in environments that have minimal power supply. It is important in the current lightweight cryptographic encryption standards; the proposed cryptographic algorithm enhances the current one that tremendously improves memory optimization and energy conservation when tested. Two of the main directions for the future work are the decrease of latency in secure communication and the improvement of the algorithm usage in the multi-hop networks.

articleTitle: Multiclass Bird Species Classification Using VGG16 and TensorFlow: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Classification of birds is of significant importance when it comes to assessment of biological diversity, or the identification of ecosystems that are most threatened. The conventional approaches to identification of species are usually very cumbersome, time consuming and are likely to contain errors since they involve experts. Consequently, this paper represents a significant challenge that can be solved by recent advances in deep learning and, more specifically, transfer learning. Building upon the VGG16 model originally developed for ImageNet, this research fine-tunes this model for bird species classification of twenty types. Specifically, transfer learning enables the model to take some features from the ImageNet dataset, thus reducing the amount of data that a model needs for training while simultaneously trapping the degree of accuracy. To control this, some of the common methods used in data augmentation were used such as random transformations. The strategies used in the increase the model's generalization ability and makes the model immune against unseen data. The proposed model obtained 94% accuracy for training dataset and 91% accuracy for test dataset for species classification. In summary, the paper demonstrates that fine tuning of pre-trained models, in conjunction with data augmentation approach, increases the classification accuracy of complicated data-related tasks such as species identification, thus making it an efficient tool for automation.

articleTitle: Cyber Hacking Breaches Prediction and Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Cyber hacks threaten organizations of every kind around the world; thus, they surely require stringent methodologies that would predict and detect them. In this paper, we discuss machine learning approaches to enhance identification and forecasting of a cyber attack by analyzing historical data. Several machine learning approaches such as decision trees, support vector machines, and neural networks are applied in sequence to extract patterns and anomalies related to potential breaches. It develops predictive models for identifying vulnerabilities and discovers features from network traffic, system logs, and user behavior up in near-real time. Metrics of performance such as accuracy, precision, and recall evaluate these algorithms to compare the effectiveness of established and emerging attack vectors. The findings suggest that machine learning significantly enhances the speed and accuracy of breach detection when compared with traditional methods. This advanced technique, applied in an organization's framework of cybersecurity, predicts cyber threats effectively and neutralizes them to increase resilience in overall security.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare with Innovative Solutions Powered by Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Large language models are driving creative solutions that are transforming the healthcare business. This paradigm change capitalizes on the promise of massive language models like BERT and GPT-3 to improve healthcare in numerous fields, including clinical text categorization, clinical decision support, and customized medication. Focusing on the algorithms, their practical implementations, and performance assessments, this article investigates the rollout and effect of these models on the healthcare scene. In the first part, we present a complete strategy that harnesses massive language models for healthcare reform. Herein, we provide three distinct algorithms: a personalized medicine recommender system; a system for classifying clinical tests using BERT; and a system for providing clinical decision assistance using LSTM. The potential for these algorithms to improve healthcare systems is highlighted by detailed mathematical definitions and explanations of how they function. Following this introduction, a comparison is made between the suggested technique and six established approaches. Accuracy, precision, recall, and the F1 score are only few of the variables used in the assessment. The findings support the superiority of the suggested strategy, indicating that healthcare outcomes and efficiency stand to benefit greatly from its implementation. Our research demonstrates the significant potential of massive language models for improving healthcare delivery. The suggested approach makes use of state-of-the-art technology to provide more precise and individualized healthcare treatments. We hope that our study will lead to the widespread use of big language models in healthcare and contribute to the ever-evolving field of medicine.

articleTitle: An Approach to Prevent Neighborhood Attack over Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Social media sites contain the personal information of the users, which entice the attackers The attacker uses several types of attacks on the social networking site in order to obtain sensitive information from the users. To protect users from active and passive social media attacks, the network operator releases anonymized data. Various third-party consumers receive data collected from social media users from operators of these platforms. The whole graph is made available in anonymized and sanitised forms by the network operator because the acquired data often contains sensitive information. But it isn't a foolproof method of keeping users' information private. In order to make social network graphs anonymous, this study developed a method based on neighbourhood adjacency matrices. One potential defence against the neighbourhood assault on social network graphs is this anonymization process.
